# DAS - Run

```{r}
for (splicing_preprocess_method_select in c("SUPPA", "rMATS")){
    
    print(splicing_preprocess_method_select)
    
    # AS PSI table, split into tissue groups
    
    # A list by tissue, for each tissue, a list of PSI tables
    AS_psi_table_tissue_list <- lapply(AS_object_qcdat, function(x){x[[paste0("AS-", splicing_preprocess_method_select)]]$AS_psi_table})
    print(lapply(AS_psi_table_tissue_list, ncol))
    
    
    # keep features that are not NA for all samples
    AS_psi_table_tissue_list <- lapply(AS_psi_table_tissue_list, function(x){x[rowSums(is.na(x)) < ncol(x), ]})
    print(lapply(AS_psi_table_tissue_list, ncol))
    
    
    # keep samples that are not NA for all features
    AS_psi_table_tissue_list <- lapply(AS_psi_table_tissue_list, function(x){x[, colSums(is.na(x)) < nrow(x)]})
    print(lapply(AS_psi_table_tissue_list, ncol))
    
    
    
    # DS analysis =====
    
    
    ds_df_list <- list()
    
    # variable_DS <- "Timepoint"
    
    variable_confounding <- c("Batch", "BMI", "calculatedAge", "codedsiteid", "pct_umi_dup", "RIN", "Sex")
    
    bool_randomEffect <- T
    variable_randomEffect <- "pid"
    
    ds_model_filename <- ifelse(bool_randomEffect,
                                yes = paste0(c(variable_confounding, variable_randomEffect), collapse = "-"),
                                no = paste0(variable_confounding, collapse = "-"))
    
    ds_model_string <- ifelse(bool_randomEffect,
                              yes = paste0(" ~ ", "Timepoint", " + ", paste0(variable_confounding, collapse = " + "), " + (1 | ", variable_randomEffect,")"),
                              no = paste0(" ~ ", "Timepoint", " + ", paste0(variable_confounding, collapse = " + ")))
    
    
    for (tissue_select in names(AS_psi_table_tissue_list)){
        
        for (exercise_group_select in c("ADUEndur", "ADUResist", "ADUControl")){
            
            # select tissue and exercise group (including both exercise and control)
            sample_metadata_df_select <- sample_metadata_df[sample_metadata_df$sampleGroupCode == tissue_name_mapping[tissue_select] & 
                                                                sample_metadata_df$randomGroupCode == exercise_group_select, ]
            
            # Select time points that are available for this exercise group
            temp_sample_number_table <- table(sample_metadata_df_select$Timepoint)
            timepoints_available <- names(temp_sample_number_table)[temp_sample_number_table >= 5]
            
            # Set baseline time point
            timepoint_baseline <- "pre_exercise"
            if (!(timepoint_baseline %in% timepoints_available)){ next }
            timepoints_exercise <- setdiff(timepoints_available, timepoint_baseline)
            
            
            # Time point contrasts
            for (timepoint_select in timepoints_exercise){
                
                print(paste(tissue_select, exercise_group_select, ":", timepoint_select, "-", timepoint_baseline))
                
                temp_samples <- sample_metadata_df_select$vialLabel[sample_metadata_df_select$Timepoint %in% c(timepoint_select, timepoint_baseline)]
                
                
                ## DS between 2 time points for both exercise and control group =====
                
                AS_psi_table <- AS_psi_table_tissue_list[[tissue_select]]
                AS_psi_table <- AS_psi_table[rowMeans(is.na(AS_psi_table)) <= 0.9, ]
                
                # Y: Splicing events data
                temp_y <- as.matrix(AS_psi_table[, temp_samples])
                temp_y <- temp_y[rowSums(is.na(temp_y)) < ncol(temp_y), , drop = F]
                temp_y <- t(temp_y)
                print(dim(temp_y))
                
                # X: confounding variables, random effects
                temp_x <- sample_metadata_df_select[temp_samples, c("Timepoint", variable_confounding, variable_randomEffect)]
                temp_x$Timepoint <- factor(temp_x$Timepoint, levels = c(timepoint_baseline, timepoint_select))
                temp_x <- as.data.frame(sapply(temp_x, as.numeric))
                
                # function for logistic regression
                temp_func <- function(i){
                    y <- temp_y[, i, drop = F]
                    x <- temp_x[!is.na(y), , drop=F]
                    y <- y[!is.na(y), , drop=F]
                    
                    if (any(table(x[, "Timepoint"]) < 3)){
                        return(data.frame())
                    }
                    
                    colnames(y) <- "AS"
                    
                    tryCatch({
                        if (bool_randomEffect){
                            suppressMessages({
                                temp_lmer <- lmerTest::lmer(as.formula(paste0("AS", ds_model_string)), 
                                                            data = cbind(as.data.frame(logit(y, adjust = 0.001)), x[, c("Timepoint", variable_confounding, variable_randomEffect)]))
                            })
                            temp_coef <- as.data.frame(coef(summary(temp_lmer)))
                            # temp_coef <- as.data.frame(anova(temp_lmer))
                            
                        }else{
                            suppressMessages({
                                temp_glm <- summary(lm(as.formula(paste0("AS", ds_model_string)),
                                                       data = cbind(as.data.frame(logit(y, adjust = 0.001)), x[, c("Timepoint", variable_confounding, variable_randomEffect)])))
                            })
                            temp_coef <- as.data.frame(stats::coef(temp_glm))
                        }
                        
                        return(temp_coef["Timepoint", , drop = F])
                    },
                    error = function(e){return(data.frame())})
                }
                
                time1 <- Sys.time()
                temp_ds_df <- mclapply(colnames(temp_y), temp_func, mc.cores = 16)
                # temp_ds_df <- mclapply(colnames(temp_y)[1:100], temp_func, mc.cores = 12)
                print(Sys.time() - time1)
                
                names(temp_ds_df) <- colnames(temp_y)
                temp_ds_df <- temp_ds_df[sapply(temp_ds_df, nrow) > 0]
                temp_ds_df <- do.call("rbind", temp_ds_df)
                temp_ds_df$feature <- row.names(temp_ds_df)
                
                
                # Add Fold Change
                temp_ds_df$log2_FoldChange <- log2(rowMeans(AS_psi_table[temp_ds_df$feature, sample_metadata_df_select$vialLabel[sample_metadata_df_select$Timepoint == timepoint_select]], na.rm = T) / 
                                                       rowMeans(AS_psi_table[temp_ds_df$feature, sample_metadata_df_select$vialLabel[sample_metadata_df_select$Timepoint == timepoint_baseline]], na.rm = T))
                
                # Add delta_psi
                temp_ds_df$diff_psi <- rowMeans(AS_psi_table[temp_ds_df$feature, sample_metadata_df_select$vialLabel[sample_metadata_df_select$Timepoint == timepoint_select]], na.rm = T) - 
                    rowMeans(AS_psi_table[temp_ds_df$feature, sample_metadata_df_select$vialLabel[sample_metadata_df_select$Timepoint == timepoint_baseline]], na.rm = T)
                
                
                # Add information
                temp_ds_df$tissue <- tissue_select
                temp_ds_df$randomGroupCode <- exercise_group_select
                temp_ds_df$timepoint_baseline <- timepoint_baseline
                temp_ds_df$timepoint_select <- timepoint_select
                temp_ds_df$AS_type <- sapply(strsplit(temp_ds_df$feature, ":", fixed = T), "[", 1)
                
                
                ds_df_list[[tissue_select]][[exercise_group_select]][[timepoint_select]] <- temp_ds_df
                
                saveRDS(list(model = ds_model_string,
                             ds_df = temp_ds_df),
                        file.path("../results_DS/temp", 
                                  paste0("DS-LR_", splicing_preprocess_method_select, "_",
                                         tissue_select, "_", exercise_group_select, "_", timepoint_select, 
                                         ".rds")))
                
            }
            
        }
        
    }
    
    
    ds_df_list <- list()
    
    for (tissue_select in names(AS_psi_table_tissue_list)){
        
        for (exercise_group_select in c("ADUEndur", "ADUResist", "ADUControl")){
            
            # select tissue and exercise group (including both exercise and control)
            sample_metadata_df_select <- sample_metadata_df[sample_metadata_df$sampleGroupCode == tissue_name_mapping[tissue_select] & 
                                                                sample_metadata_df$randomGroupCode == exercise_group_select, ]
            
            # Select time points that are available for this exercise group
            temp_sample_number_table <- table(sample_metadata_df_select$Timepoint)
            timepoints_available <- names(temp_sample_number_table)[temp_sample_number_table >= 5]
            
            # Set baseline time point
            timepoint_baseline <- "pre_exercise"
            if (!(timepoint_baseline %in% timepoints_available)){ next }
            timepoints_exercise <- setdiff(timepoints_available, timepoint_baseline)
            
            
            # Time point contrasts
            for (timepoint_select in timepoints_exercise){
                
                print(paste(tissue_select, exercise_group_select, ":", timepoint_select, "-", timepoint_baseline))
                
                temp <- readRDS(file.path("../results_DS/temp", 
                                          paste0("DS-LR_", splicing_preprocess_method_select, "_",
                                                 tissue_select, "_", exercise_group_select, "_", timepoint_select, 
                                                 ".rds")))
                temp_ds_df <- temp$ds_df
                
                ds_df_list[[tissue_select]][[exercise_group_select]][[timepoint_select]] <- temp_ds_df
                
            }
        }
    }
    
    saveRDS(list(model = ds_model_string,
                 ds_df_list = ds_df_list),
            file.path("../results_DS/", 
                      paste0("DS-LR_", splicing_preprocess_method_select, "_", ds_model_filename, ".rds")))
}
```


# Save All DAS results

```{r}
DS_df_allMethods_list <- list()

for (splicing_preprocess_method_select in c("SUPPA", "rMATS")){
    
    # Method specific gene annotation for AS features =====
    gene_info_df <- gene_info_df_allMethods_list[[splicing_preprocess_method_select]]
    
    
    # DS results =====
    variable_confounding <- c("Batch", "BMI", "calculatedAge", "codedsiteid", "pct_umi_dup", "RIN", "Sex")
    
    bool_randomEffect <- T
    variable_randomEffect <- "pid"
    
    ds_model_filename <- ifelse(bool_randomEffect,
                                yes = paste0(c(variable_confounding, variable_randomEffect), collapse = "-"),
                                no = paste0(variable_confounding, collapse = "-"))
    
    ds_df_list <- readRDS(file.path("../results_DS/", 
                                    paste0("DS-LR_", splicing_preprocess_method_select, "_", ds_model_filename, ".rds")))
    ds_model_string <- ds_df_list$model
    ds_df_list <- ds_df_list$ds_df_list
    
    
    # Create a large table =====
    ds_df_list <- lapply(ds_df_list, 
                         function(x){do.call("rbind", lapply(x, 
                                                             function(y){do.call("rbind", lapply(y,
                                                                                                 function(z){
                                                                                                     z$p_value <- z$`Pr(>|t|)`
                                                                                                     z$adj_p_value <- p.adjust(z$p_value, method = "fdr")
                                                                                                     z <- merge(z,
                                                                                                                gene_info_df[, c("event_id", "gene_id")],
                                                                                                                by.x = "feature", by.y = "event_id", all.x = T, sort = F)
                                                                                                     return(z)
                                                                                                 }))}))})
    
    ds_df_list <- lapply(ds_df_list,
                         function(x){
                             # x$AS_preprocessing_method <- splicing_preprocess_method_select
                             x$assay <- paste0("AS-", splicing_preprocess_method_select)
                             x$contrast <- paste0(x$randomGroupCode, ".", x$timepoint_select, " - ",
                                                  x$randomGroupCode, ".", x$timepoint_baseline)
                             # x$model <- ds_model_string
                             return(data.table(x))
                         })
    
    # filter for the selected union of AS features
    ds_df_list <- sapply(names(ds_df_list),
                         function(x){
                             return(ds_df_list[[x]][ds_df_list[[x]]$feature %in% features_test_union_tissue_list[[x]], ])
                         },
                         USE.NAMES = T, simplify = F)
    
    DS_df_allMethods_list[[paste0("AS-", splicing_preprocess_method_select)]] <- ds_df_list
   
}
```

# Sig Union dataframe

```{r}
# Create sig_DS_df by combining results from all methods

DS_df_allMethods_list <- list()
sig_DS_df_allMethods_list <- list()

temp_AS_methods_select <- c("SUPPA", "rMATS")

# for (splicing_preprocess_method_select in names(AS_psi_table_allMethods_list)){
for (splicing_preprocess_method_select in temp_AS_methods_select){
    
    # DS results =====
    variable_confounding <- c("Batch", "BMI", "calculatedAge", "codedsiteid", "pct_umi_dup", "RIN", "Sex")
    
    bool_randomEffect <- T
    variable_randomEffect <- "pid"
    
    ds_model_filename <- ifelse(bool_randomEffect,
                                yes = paste0(c(variable_confounding, variable_randomEffect), collapse = "-"),
                                no = paste0(variable_confounding, collapse = "-"))
    
    ds_df_list <- readRDS(file.path("../results_DS/", 
                                    paste0("DS-LR_", splicing_preprocess_method_select, "_", ds_model_filename, ".rds")))
    ds_model_string <- ds_df_list$model
    ds_df_list <- ds_df_list$ds_df_list
    
    DS_df_allMethods_list[[splicing_preprocess_method_select]] <- ds_df_list
    
    
    # Sig DS results =====
    sig_DS_df_list <- list()
    
    for (tissue_select in names(ds_df_list)){
        
        control_group_select <- "ADUControl"
        
        for (exercise_group_select in c("ADUEndur", "ADUResist")){
            
            # Actual time points tested for DS (other time points don't have enough samples)
            timepoints_tested <- intersect(names(ds_df_list[[tissue_select]][[exercise_group_select]]),
                                           names(ds_df_list[[tissue_select]][[control_group_select]]))
            
            # temp_df_sig_list <- list()
            for (timepoint_select in timepoints_tested){
                
                temp_df_exe <- ds_df_list[[tissue_select]][[exercise_group_select]][[timepoint_select]]
                temp_df_con <- ds_df_list[[tissue_select]][[control_group_select]][[timepoint_select]]
                
                # filter to selected union of features of SUPPA and rMATS
                temp_df_exe <- temp_df_exe[temp_df_exe$feature %in% features_test_union_tissue_list[[tissue_select]], ]
                temp_df_con <- temp_df_con[temp_df_con$feature %in% features_test_union_tissue_list[[tissue_select]], ]
                
                # Get FDR
                temp_df_exe$fdr <- p.adjust(temp_df_exe$`Pr(>|t|)`, method = "fdr")
                temp_df_con$fdr <- p.adjust(temp_df_con$`Pr(>|t|)`, method = "fdr")
                
                # Only checking features appearing in both exercise anbd control
                temp_features_intersect <- intersect(row.names(temp_df_exe), row.names(temp_df_con))
                temp_df_exe <- temp_df_exe[temp_features_intersect, ]
                temp_df_con <- temp_df_con[temp_features_intersect, ]
                
                # Significance: 
                # 1. significant in Exercise, AND
                # 2. insignificant in Control, OR significant in different direction in Control
                temp_df_exe <- temp_df_exe[!is.na(temp_df_exe$fdr) & !is.na(temp_df_con$fdr) & 
                                               temp_df_exe$fdr < 0.05 & 
                                               (temp_df_con$fdr > 0.05 | (temp_df_exe$Estimate * temp_df_con$Estimate) < 0), ]
                
                
                sig_DS_df_list[[tissue_select]][[exercise_group_select]][[timepoint_select]] <- temp_df_exe
            }
        }
    }
    
    sig_DS_df_allMethods_list[[splicing_preprocess_method_select]] <- sig_DS_df_list
    
}
```

```{r}
sig_DS_union_df_list <- list()

for (tissue_select in c("adipose", "blood", "muscle")){
    
    control_group_select <- "ADUControl"
    
    for (exercise_group_select in c("ADUEndur", "ADUResist")){
        
        timepoints_tested <- Reduce("union",
                                    lapply(sig_DS_df_allMethods_list, function(x){names(x[[tissue_select]][[exercise_group_select]])}))
        
        for (timepoint_select in timepoints_tested){
            
            temp_sig_features_allMethods_list <- lapply(sig_DS_df_allMethods_list, function(x){x[[tissue_select]][[exercise_group_select]][[timepoint_select]]$feature})
            temp_sig_features_union <- Reduce("union", temp_sig_features_allMethods_list)
            
            # Get DE info for features significant in at leat one method
            temp_df_1 <- DS_df_allMethods_list[[temp_AS_methods_select[1]]][[tissue_select]][[exercise_group_select]][[timepoint_select]]
            temp_df_2 <- DS_df_allMethods_list[[temp_AS_methods_select[2]]][[tissue_select]][[exercise_group_select]][[timepoint_select]]
            
            temp_df_1$fdr <- p.adjust(temp_df_1$`Pr(>|t|)`, method = "fdr")
            temp_df_2$fdr <- p.adjust(temp_df_2$`Pr(>|t|)`, method = "fdr")
            
            temp_df_1 <- temp_df_1[temp_df_1$feature %in% temp_sig_features_union, ]
            temp_df_2 <- temp_df_2[temp_df_2$feature %in% temp_sig_features_union, ]
            
            # Organize colnames
            colnames_DS <- c("Estimate", "Std. Error", "df", "t value", "Pr(>|t|)", "log2_FoldChange", "diff_psi", "fdr")
            temp_df_1 <- temp_df_1[, c("feature", colnames_DS)]
            temp_df_2 <- temp_df_2[, c("feature", colnames_DS)]
            
            colnames_DS_rename <- c("Estimate", "Std_Error", "df", "t_value", "p_value", "log2_FoldChange", "diff_psi", "fdr")
            colnames(temp_df_1) <- c("feature", paste0(colnames_DS_rename, "_", temp_AS_methods_select[1]))
            colnames(temp_df_2) <- c("feature", paste0(colnames_DS_rename, "_", temp_AS_methods_select[2]))
            
            # merge the sig data frames from two methods
            temp_df_merge <- merge(temp_df_1, temp_df_2, by = "feature", all = T)
            
            temp_df_merge[[paste0("sig_in_", temp_AS_methods_select[1])]] <- temp_df_merge$feature %in% temp_sig_features_allMethods_list[[temp_AS_methods_select[1]]]
            temp_df_merge[[paste0("sig_in_", temp_AS_methods_select[2])]] <- temp_df_merge$feature %in% temp_sig_features_allMethods_list[[temp_AS_methods_select[2]]]
            
            # Add info
            temp_df_merge$AS_type <- sapply(strsplit(temp_df_merge$feature, split = ":"), "[", 1)
            temp_df_merge$tissue <- tissue_select
            temp_df_merge$randomGroupCode <- exercise_group_select
            temp_df_merge$timepoint_baseline <- "pre_exercise"
            temp_df_merge$timepoint_select <- timepoint_select
            
            sig_DS_union_df_list[[tissue_select]][[exercise_group_select]][[timepoint_select]] <- temp_df_merge
        }
    }
}
```

```{r}
# consolidate into one gene_id
```

```{r}
# For the events in SUPPA, check whether the alternative transcript IDs correspond to a possible change in protein sequence

# temp_gene_info_df <- gene_info_df_allMethods_list$SUPPA
temp_gene_info_df <- gene_info_df_SUPPA
temp_gene_info_df <- temp_gene_info_df[temp_gene_info_df$event_id %in% sig_feature_info_df$feature, ]

temp_func <- function(x){
    if (x %in% temp_gene_info_df$event_id){
        inc_txs <- unique(unlist(strsplit(temp_gene_info_df[temp_gene_info_df$event_id == x, inclusion_transcripts], ",")))
        exc_txs <- setdiff(unique(unlist(strsplit(temp_gene_info_df[temp_gene_info_df$event_id == x, total_transcripts], ","))), 
                           inc_txs)
        
        # See if any overlap in protein lengths between inclusion and exclusion transcripts
        inc_txs <- transcripts(edb, filter = TxIdFilter(inc_txs), columns = c("tx_id", "protein_id", "protein_sequence"))
        inc_txs_prt_seqs <- inc_txs$protein_sequence
        inc_txs_prt_seqs <- inc_txs_prt_seqs[!is.na(inc_txs_prt_seqs)]
        
        exc_txs <- transcripts(edb, filter = TxIdFilter(exc_txs), columns = c("tx_id", "protein_id", "protein_sequence"))
        exc_txs_prt_seqs <- exc_txs$protein_sequence
        exc_txs_prt_seqs <- exc_txs_prt_seqs[!is.na(exc_txs_prt_seqs)]
        
        # if inclusion and exclusion transcripts both have protein sequences, and their protein sequences have no overlap
        if ((length(inc_txs_prt_seqs) > 0 | length(exc_txs_prt_seqs) > 0) & length(intersect(inc_txs_prt_seqs, exc_txs_prt_seqs)) == 0){
            return(TRUE)
        }else{
            return(FALSE)
        }
        
    }else{
        return(FALSE)
    }
}

sig_feature_info_df$inc_exc_tx_prt_diff <- sapply(sig_feature_info_df$feature, temp_func)
```

# DAS - Analysis

```{r}
DS_df_allMethods_list <- list()
sig_DS_df_allMethods_list <- list()

temp_AS_methods_select <- c("SUPPA", "rMATS")

for (splicing_preprocess_method_select in temp_AS_methods_select){
    
    # Method specific gene annotation for AS features =====
    gene_info_df <- gene_info_df_allMethods_list[[splicing_preprocess_method_select]]
    
    
    # DS results =====
    variable_confounding <- c("Batch", "BMI", "calculatedAge", "codedsiteid", "pct_umi_dup", "RIN", "Sex")
    
    bool_randomEffect <- T
    variable_randomEffect <- "pid"
    
    ds_model_filename <- ifelse(bool_randomEffect,
                                yes = paste0(c(variable_confounding, variable_randomEffect), collapse = "-"),
                                no = paste0(variable_confounding, collapse = "-"))
    
    ds_df_list <- readRDS(file.path("../results_DS/", 
                                    paste0("DS-LR_", splicing_preprocess_method_select, "_", ds_model_filename, ".rds")))
    ds_model_string <- ds_df_list$model
    ds_df_list <- ds_df_list$ds_df_list
    
    DS_df_allMethods_list[[splicing_preprocess_method_select]] <- ds_df_list
    
    
    # Sig DS results =====
    sig_DS_df_list <- list()
    
    for (tissue_select in names(ds_df_list)){
        
        control_group_select <- "ADUControl"
        
        for (exercise_group_select in c("ADUEndur", "ADUResist")){
            
            # Actual time points tested for DS (other time points don't have enough samples)
            timepoints_tested <- intersect(names(ds_df_list[[tissue_select]][[exercise_group_select]]),
                                           names(ds_df_list[[tissue_select]][[control_group_select]]))
            
            temp_df_sig_list <- list()
            for (timepoint_select in timepoints_tested){
                
                temp_df_exe <- ds_df_list[[tissue_select]][[exercise_group_select]][[timepoint_select]]
                temp_df_con <- ds_df_list[[tissue_select]][[control_group_select]][[timepoint_select]]
                
                # filter to selected union of feature of SUPPA and rMATS
                temp_df_exe <- temp_df_exe[temp_df_exe$feature %in% features_test_union_tissue_list[[tissue_select]], ]
                temp_df_con <- temp_df_con[temp_df_con$feature %in% features_test_union_tissue_list[[tissue_select]], ]
                
                # Get FDR
                temp_df_exe$fdr <- p.adjust(temp_df_exe$`Pr(>|t|)`, method = "fdr")
                temp_df_con$fdr <- p.adjust(temp_df_con$`Pr(>|t|)`, method = "fdr")
                
                # Only checking features appearing in both exercise anbd control
                temp_features_intersect <- intersect(row.names(temp_df_exe), row.names(temp_df_con))
                temp_df_exe <- temp_df_exe[temp_features_intersect, ]
                temp_df_con <- temp_df_con[temp_features_intersect, ]
                
                # Significance: 
                # 1. significant in Exercise, AND
                # 2. insignificant in Control, OR significant in different direction in Control
                temp_df_exe <- temp_df_exe[!is.na(temp_df_exe$fdr) & !is.na(temp_df_con$fdr) & 
                                               temp_df_exe$fdr < 0.05 & 
                                               (temp_df_con$fdr > 0.05 | (temp_df_exe$Estimate * temp_df_con$Estimate) < 0), ]
                
                
                # Add AS preprocessing method
                temp_df_exe$AS_preprocessing_method <- splicing_preprocess_method_select
                
                # Add gene info
                temp_df_exe <- merge(temp_df_exe, gene_info_df[, c("event_id", "gene_id")], by.x = "feature", by.y = "event_id", all.x = T, sort = F)
                
                temp_df_sig_list[[timepoint_select]] <- temp_df_exe
            }
            
            # Combine all time points into one data frame
            temp_df_sig <- do.call("rbind", temp_df_sig_list)
            
            sig_DS_df_list[[tissue_select]][[exercise_group_select]] <- temp_df_sig
            
        }
    }
    
    sig_DS_df_allMethods_list[[splicing_preprocess_method_select]] <- sig_DS_df_list
    
}
```

```{r}
sig_DS_number_list <- list()

for (tissue_select in names(ds_df_list)){
    
    control_group_select <- "ADUControl"
    
    for (exercise_group_select in c("ADUEndur", "ADUResist")){
        
        # Actual time points tested for DS (other time points don't have enough samples)
        timepoints_tested <- intersect(names(ds_df_list[[tissue_select]][[exercise_group_select]]),
                                       names(ds_df_list[[tissue_select]][[control_group_select]]))
        
        temp_df_sig_allMethods_list <- lapply(sig_DS_df_allMethods_list, function(x){x[[tissue_select]][[exercise_group_select]]})
        temp_df_sig <- do.call("rbind", temp_df_sig_allMethods_list)
        
        # Expand the result table to potentially contain all time points
        temp_df_sig$timepoint_select <- factor(temp_df_sig$timepoint_select, levels = setdiff(timepoints_levels, "pre_exercise"))
        
        # Add the tissue-specific exact time points
        temp_df_sig <- add_exact_timepoint(temp_df_sig, tissue_col = "tissue", tissue_name_mapping = NULL, timepoint_col = "timepoint_select")
        temp_df_sig$Timepoint_exact <- factor(temp_df_sig$Timepoint_exact, levels = setdiff(timepoints_levels_exact, "pre_exercise"))
        
        # Before getting the number, take union of features from two method for each time point
        temp_df_sig <- temp_df_sig[!duplicated(paste0(temp_df_sig$feature, "_", temp_df_sig$Timepoint_exact)), ]
        
        print(table(temp_df_sig$Timepoint_exact))
        
        # Number of significance
        temp_sig_num_mtx <- as.matrix(table(temp_df_sig$AS_type, temp_df_sig$Timepoint_exact))
        
        # for time points not tested, change to NA
        temp_sig_num_mtx[, !(colnames(temp_sig_num_mtx) %in% convert_to_exact_timepoint(timepoints_vec = timepoints_tested, tissue = tissue_select))] <- NA
        
        row.names(temp_sig_num_mtx) <- paste0(tissue_select, "_", exercise_group_select, "_", row.names(temp_sig_num_mtx))
        
        sig_DS_number_list[[tissue_select]][[exercise_group_select]] <- temp_sig_num_mtx
        
    }
}
```

```{r}
    de_gene_df <- de_gene_df_list[[tissue_select]]
    de_gene_df$gene_id <- gsub("\\.[0-9]+$", "", de_gene_df$feature_id)
    
    de_gene_df <- de_gene_df[, c("gene_id", "contrast", "logFC", "p_value", "adj_p_value")]
    colnames(de_gene_df) <- c("gene_id", "contrast", "logFC_gene", "p_value_gene", "adj_p_value_gene")
    
    
    # # protein de info
    # de_protein_df <- de_protein_df_list[[tissue_select]]
    # if (!is.null(de_protein_df)){
    #     de_protein_feature_meta_df <- qcdat[[tissue_select]][["prot-pr"]]$feature_metadata
    #     de_protein_df <- merge(de_protein_df, de_protein_feature_meta_df[, c("id", "gene_symbol")], by.x = "feature_id", by.y = "id", all.x = T)
    #     
    #     de_protein_df <- de_protein_df[, c("gene_symbol", "contrast", "logFC", "p_value", "adj_p_value")]
    #     colnames(de_protein_df) <- c("gene_symbol", "contrast", "logFC_protein", "p_value_protein", "adj_p_value_protein")
    # }
            
    
    for (exercise_group_select in c("ADUEndur", "ADUResist")){
        
        # differential splicing
        # temp_sig_DS_df <- sig_DS_df_list[[tissue_select]][[exercise_group_select]]
        temp_sig_DS_df_allMethods_list <- lapply(sig_DS_df_allMethods_list, function(x){x[[tissue_select]][[exercise_group_select]]})
        temp_sig_DS_df <- do.call("rbind", temp_sig_DS_df_allMethods_list)
        
        # Take the union of sig AS features from two method for each time point
        temp_sig_DS_df <- temp_sig_DS_df[!duplicated(paste0(temp_sig_DS_df$feature, "_", temp_sig_DS_df$timepoint_select)), ]
        
        # Add exact timepoint
        temp_sig_DS_df <- add_exact_timepoint(temp_sig_DS_df, tissue_col = "tissue", timepoint_col = "timepoint_select")
        
        # For each time point
        # timepoints_tested <- intersect(temp_sig_DS_df$Timepoint_exact,
        #                                de_gene_df$Timepoint_exact)
        timepoints_tested <- unique(temp_sig_DS_df$Timepoint_exact)
        timepoints_tested <- levels(sample_metadata_df$Timepoint_exact)[levels(sample_metadata_df$Timepoint_exact) %in% timepoints_tested]
        
        
        for (timepoint_select in timepoints_tested){
            
            # NOTE: Since 2024-Dec, dadat has been modified, it now includes both single and double contrasts, and "contrast1_timepoint" is NA for some double contrasts 
            # Should just use the contrast string to select the corresponding comparison
            da_contrast_string_select <- paste0("group_timepoint", exercise_group_select, ".", timepoint_exact_to_range_vec[timepoint_select], " - ",
                                                "group_timepoint", exercise_group_select, ".", timepoint_exact_to_range_vec[timepoint_baseline], " - ",
                                                "group_timepoint", control_group_select, ".", timepoint_exact_to_range_vec[timepoint_select], " + ",
                                                "group_timepoint", control_group_select, ".", timepoint_exact_to_range_vec[timepoint_baseline])
            
            # Add gene DE info
            temp_df <- merge(temp_sig_DS_df[temp_sig_DS_df$Timepoint_exact == timepoint_select, ],
                             de_gene_df[de_gene_df$contrast == da_contrast_string_select, c("gene_id", "logFC_gene", "p_value_gene", "adj_p_value_gene")],
                             by = "gene_id", all.x = T)
            
            temp_df$AS_non_DE <- !is.na(temp_df$adj_p_value_gene) & temp_df$adj_p_value_gene > 0.05
            
            # # Add protein DE info
            # temp_df <- merge(temp_df, MOTRPAC_HUMAN_ENSEMBL_GENE_MAP[, c("ensembl_gene", "gene_symbol")], by.x = "gene_id", by.y = "ensembl_gene", all.x = T)
            # 
            # temp_df <- merge(temp_df, 
            #                  de_protein_df[de_protein_df$contrast == da_contrast_string_select, c("gene_symbol", "logFC_protein", "p_value_protein", "adj_p_value_protein")],
            #                  by = "gene_symbol", all.x = T)
            # 
            # temp_df$AS_protein_DE <- !is.na(temp_df$adj_p_value_protein) & temp_df$adj_p_value_protein < 0.05
            
            # print(table(temp_df$AS_non_DE, temp_df$AS_protein_DE))
            
            
            temp_merged_df_list[[paste0(tissue_select, "-", exercise_group_select, "-", timepoint_select)]] <- temp_df
            
            
        }
        
    }
    
    sig_DS_nonDE_df <- do.call("rbind", temp_merged_df_list)
    sig_DS_nonDE_df <- data.table(sig_DS_nonDE_df)
    
    sig_DS_nonDE_df$AS_type <- factor(AS_type_renaming_vector[sig_DS_nonDE_df$AS_type], levels = AS_type_renaming_vector)
    sig_DS_nonDE_df$Group <- factor(group_renaming_vector[sig_DS_nonDE_df$randomGroupCode], levels = group_renaming_vector)
    
    sig_DS_nonDE_df$Timepoint_exact_description <- droplevels(factor(timepoint_description_vec[as.character(sig_DS_nonDE_df$Timepoint_exact)], levels = timepoint_description_vec))
    
    # Bar plot showing AS without DEG and AS with DEG
    sig_DS_nonDE_num_df <- sig_DS_nonDE_df[, .(Num_AS = length(unique(feature)), Num_gene = length(unique(gene_id))), 
                                           by = .(tissue, Group, Timepoint_exact_description, AS_type, AS_non_DE)]
    sig_DS_nonDE_num_df$Type <- ifelse(sig_DS_nonDE_num_df$AS_non_DE, yes = "DAS only", no = "DAS-DEG")
    sig_DS_nonDE_num_df$Type <- factor(sig_DS_nonDE_num_df$Type, levels = c("DAS only", "DAS-DEG"))
    
    p1 <- ggplot(sig_DS_nonDE_num_df) + 
        # geom_bar(aes(x = AS_type, y = Num_gene, fill = Type), stat = "identity", color = "#222222") + 
        geom_bar(aes(x = AS_type, y = Num_AS, fill = Type), stat = "identity", color = "#222222") + 
        scale_fill_manual(values = setNames(c("#2288EE", "#AAAABA"), c("DAS only", "DAS-DEG"))) + 
        facet_grid(Group ~ Timepoint_exact_description) + 
        # xlab("AS type") + ylab("Number of genes") + 
        xlab("AS type") + ylab("Number of events") + 
        theme_minimal() + 
        theme(strip.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
              strip.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
              legend.title = element_text(size = 14),
              legend.text = element_text(size = 12)) +
        ggtitle(tissue_select)
    print(p1)
    
    ggsave(file.path("../results_DS/figs_DS-nonDE/", paste0("Bar-DS-nonDE_", tissue_select, ".png")), p1, width = 1.75 + length(unique(sig_DS_nonDE_num_df$Timepoint_exact_description))*1.75, height = 3.5)
    
    ggsave(file.path("../results_DS/figs_DS-nonDE/", paste0("Bar-DS-nonDE_", tissue_select, ".pdf")), p1, width = 1.75 + length(unique(sig_DS_nonDE_num_df$Timepoint_exact_description))*1.75, height = 3.5)
    
    ggsave(file.path("../results_DS/figs_DS-nonDE/", paste0("Bar-DS-nonDE_", tissue_select, ".svg")), p1, width = 1.75 + length(unique(sig_DS_nonDE_num_df$Timepoint_exact_description))*1.75, height = 3.5)
    
    
    sig_DS_nonDE_num_df$tissue <- tissue_select
    sig_DS_nonDE_num_df_all[[tissue_select]] <- sig_DS_nonDE_num_df

}

sig_DS_nonDE_num_df_all <- do.call("rbind", sig_DS_nonDE_num_df_all)
```

```{r}
sig_DS_CDS_num_df_all <- list()

for (tissue_select in names(sig_DS_df_allMethods_list[["SUPPA"]])){
    
    temp_merged_df_list <- list()

    for (exercise_group_select in c("ADUEndur", "ADUResist")){
        
        # differential splicing
        temp_sig_DS_df_allMethods_list <- lapply(sig_DS_df_allMethods_list, function(x){x[[tissue_select]][[exercise_group_select]]})
        temp_sig_DS_df <- do.call("rbind", temp_sig_DS_df_allMethods_list)
        
        # Take the union of sig AS features from two method for each time point
        temp_sig_DS_df <- temp_sig_DS_df[!duplicated(paste0(temp_sig_DS_df$feature, "_", temp_sig_DS_df$timepoint_select)), ]
        
        # Add exact timepoint
        temp_sig_DS_df <- add_exact_timepoint(temp_sig_DS_df, tissue_col = "tissue", timepoint_col = "timepoint_select")
        
        # For each time point
        timepoints_tested <- unique(temp_sig_DS_df$Timepoint_exact)
        timepoints_tested <- levels(sample_metadata_df$Timepoint_exact)[levels(sample_metadata_df$Timepoint_exact) %in% timepoints_tested]
        
        
        for (timepoint_select in timepoints_tested){
            
            # Add gene DE info
            temp_df <- merge(temp_sig_DS_df[temp_sig_DS_df$Timepoint_exact == timepoint_select, ],
                             sig_feature_info_df[, c("feature", "gene_symbol", "alt_exon_coords", "alt_exon_has_prt", "inc_exc_tx_prt_diff")],
                             by = "feature", all.x = T)
            
            temp_merged_df_list[[paste0(tissue_select, "-", exercise_group_select, "-", timepoint_select)]] <- temp_df
            
        }
        
    }
    
    sig_DS_CDS_df <- do.call("rbind", temp_merged_df_list)
    sig_DS_CDS_df <- data.table(sig_DS_CDS_df)
    
    sig_DS_CDS_df$AS_type <- factor(AS_type_renaming_vector[sig_DS_CDS_df$AS_type], levels = AS_type_renaming_vector)
    sig_DS_CDS_df$Group <- factor(group_renaming_vector[sig_DS_CDS_df$randomGroupCode], levels = group_renaming_vector)
    
    sig_DS_CDS_df$Timepoint_exact_description <- droplevels(factor(timepoint_description_vec[as.character(sig_DS_CDS_df$Timepoint_exact)], levels = timepoint_description_vec))
    
    # levels of annotated CDS correspondence
    sig_DS_CDS_df$CDS_change <- "No CDS change"
    sig_DS_CDS_df$CDS_change <- ifelse(sig_DS_CDS_df$alt_exon_has_prt, yes = "Direct CDS change", no = sig_DS_CDS_df$CDS_change)
    sig_DS_CDS_df$CDS_change <- ifelse(!(sig_DS_CDS_df$alt_exon_has_prt) & sig_DS_CDS_df$inc_exc_tx_prt_diff, yes = "Indirect CDS change", no = sig_DS_CDS_df$CDS_change)
    
    # Bar plot showing AS without DEG and AS with DEG
    sig_DS_CDS_num_df <- sig_DS_CDS_df[, .(Num_AS = length(unique(feature)), Num_gene = length(unique(gene_id))), 
                                       by = .(tissue, Group, Timepoint_exact_description, AS_type, CDS_change)]
    temp_cds_change_levels <- c("CDS change", "Likely CDS change", "No CDS change")
    sig_DS_CDS_num_df$CDS_change <- setNames(temp_cds_change_levels, 
                                             c("Direct CDS change", "Indirect CDS change", "No CDS change"))[sig_DS_CDS_num_df$CDS_change]
    sig_DS_CDS_num_df$CDS_change <- factor(sig_DS_CDS_num_df$CDS_change, levels = temp_cds_change_levels)
    
    p1 <- ggplot(sig_DS_CDS_num_df) + 
        # geom_bar(aes(x = AS_type, y = Num_gene, fill = CDS_change), stat = "identity", color = "#222222") + 
        geom_bar(aes(x = AS_type, y = Num_AS, fill = CDS_change), stat = "identity", color = "#222222") + 
        scale_fill_manual(values = setNames(c("#CC5511", "#EE9922", "#CCCCCC"), levels(sig_DS_CDS_num_df$CDS_change))) + 
        guides(fill = guide_legend(title = "CDS change")) + 
        facet_grid(Group ~ Timepoint_exact_description) + 
        xlab("AS type") + 
        # ylab("Number of genes") + 
        ylab("Number of events") + 
        theme_minimal() + 
        theme(legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
              strip.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
              strip.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
              axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8)) +
        ggtitle(tissue_select)
    print(p1)
    
    ggsave(file.path("../results_protein/figs_protein_cds_change/", paste0("Bar-DS-cds_", tissue_select, ".png")), p1, width = 1.75 + length(unique(sig_DS_CDS_num_df$Timepoint_exact_description))*1.75, height = 3.5)
    ggsave(file.path("../results_protein/figs_protein_cds_change/", paste0("Bar-DS-cds_", tissue_select, ".pdf")), p1, width = 1.75 + length(unique(sig_DS_CDS_num_df$Timepoint_exact_description))*1.75, height = 3.5)
    ggsave(file.path("../results_protein/figs_protein_cds_change/", paste0("Bar-DS-cds_", tissue_select, ".svg")), p1, width = 1.75 + length(unique(sig_DS_CDS_num_df$Timepoint_exact_description))*1.75, height = 3.5)
    
    
    sig_DS_CDS_num_df$tissue <- tissue_select
    sig_DS_CDS_num_df_all[[tissue_select]] <- sig_DS_CDS_num_df
}

sig_DS_CDS_num_df_all <- do.call("rbind", sig_DS_CDS_num_df_all)
```

```{r}
# Venn diagrams

# For each time point, compare between 2 groups ==========

tissue_select <- "muscle"

for (tissue_select in names(sig_DS_df_allMethods_list[["SUPPA"]])){
    
    timepoints_tested <- intersect(names(DS_df_allMethods_list[["SUPPA"]][[tissue_select]]$ADUEndur), 
                                   names(DS_df_allMethods_list[["SUPPA"]][[tissue_select]]$ADUResist))
    
    for (timepoint_select in timepoints_tested){
        
        temp_df_1 <- do.call("rbind", lapply(sig_DS_df_allMethods_list, function(x){x[[tissue_select]]$ADUEndur}))
        temp_df_2 <- do.call("rbind", lapply(sig_DS_df_allMethods_list, function(x){x[[tissue_select]]$ADUResist}))
        
        temp_sig_ds_list <- list(ADUEndur = unique(temp_df_1$gene_id[temp_df_1$timepoint_select == timepoint_select]),
                                 ADUResist = unique(temp_df_2$gene_id[temp_df_2$timepoint_select == timepoint_select]))
        
        if (any(sapply(temp_sig_ds_list, length) == 0)) { next }
        
        temp_plot_order <- length(temp_sig_ds_list[[1]]) > length(temp_sig_ds_list[[2]])
        venn.diagram(temp_sig_ds_list,
                     filename = file.path("../results_DS/figs_venn/", paste0("Venn-cross-group_", tissue_select, "_", timepoint_select, ".png")), height = 800, width = 800,
                     fill = annot_colors_use_list$group[names(temp_sig_ds_list)], alpha = rep(0.7, times = length(temp_sig_ds_list)),
                     # rotation.degree = ifelse(length(temp_sig_ds_list[[1]]) < length(temp_sig_ds_list[[2]]), yes = 90, no = -90),
                     inverted = temp_plot_order, 
                     rotation.degree = 90,
                     cat.pos = ifelse(rep(length(temp_sig_ds_list[[1]]) < length(temp_sig_ds_list[[2]]), 2), yes = c(180, 0), no = c(0, 180)), cat.cex = 0, cex = 0.9,
                     # main = timepoint_select, main.cex = 0.8,
                     euler.d = T, scaled = T, disable.logging = T)
        
        pdf(file = file.path("../results_DS/figs_venn/", paste0("Venn-cross-group_", tissue_select, "_", timepoint_select, ".pdf")), width = 1.5, height = 1.5)
        temp <- venn.diagram(temp_sig_ds_list,
                             filename = NULL,
                     fill = annot_colors_use_list$group[names(temp_sig_ds_list)], alpha = rep(0.7, times = length(temp_sig_ds_list)),
                     # rotation.degree = ifelse(length(temp_sig_ds_list[[1]]) < length(temp_sig_ds_list[[2]]), yes = 90, no = -90),
                     inverted = temp_plot_order, 
                     rotation.degree = 90,
                     cat.pos = ifelse(rep(length(temp_sig_ds_list[[1]]) < length(temp_sig_ds_list[[2]]), 2), yes = c(180, 0), no = c(0, 180)), cat.cex = 0, cex = 0.9,
                     # main = timepoint_select, main.cex = 0.8,
                     euler.d = T, scaled = T, disable.logging = T)
        grid.draw(temp)
        dev.off()
        
        svg(file = file.path("../results_DS/figs_venn/", paste0("Venn-cross-group_", tissue_select, "_", timepoint_select, ".svg")), width = 1.5, height = 1.5)
        temp <- venn.diagram(temp_sig_ds_list,
                             filename = NULL,
                     fill = annot_colors_use_list$group[names(temp_sig_ds_list)], alpha = rep(0.7, times = length(temp_sig_ds_list)),
                     # rotation.degree = ifelse(length(temp_sig_ds_list[[1]]) < length(temp_sig_ds_list[[2]]), yes = 90, no = -90),
                     inverted = temp_plot_order, 
                     rotation.degree = 90,
                     cat.pos = ifelse(rep(length(temp_sig_ds_list[[1]]) < length(temp_sig_ds_list[[2]]), 2), yes = c(180, 0), no = c(0, 180)), cat.cex = 0, cex = 0.9,
                     # main = timepoint_select, main.cex = 0.8,
                     euler.d = T, scaled = T, disable.logging = T)
        grid.draw(temp)
        dev.off()
        
    }
}

        temp_df_2 <- do.call("rbind", lapply(sig_DS_df_allMethods_list, function(x){x[[tissue_select]]$ADUResist}))
        
        temp_sig_ds_list <- list(ADUEndur = unique(temp_df_1$gene_id[temp_df_1$timepoint_select == timepoint_select]),
                                 ADUResist = unique(temp_df_2$gene_id[temp_df_2$timepoint_select == timepoint_select]))
        
        if (any(sapply(temp_sig_ds_list, length) == 0)) { next }
        
        temp_num_df <- rbind(temp_num_df,
                             data.frame(tissue = tissue_select,
                                        timepoint = timepoint_select,
                                        Num_shared = length(Reduce("intersect", temp_sig_ds_list)),

    }
}
```

```{r}
# Analyze overlap between groups and find GO enrichment for each overlap ==========

tissue_select <- "muscle"

timepoints_tested <- intersect(names(DS_df_allMethods_list[["SUPPA"]][[tissue_select]]$ADUEndur), 
                               names(DS_df_allMethods_list[["SUPPA"]][[tissue_select]]$ADUResist))


## Significant genes -----

temp_DSgenes_byTime_list <- list()

for (timepoint_select in timepoints_tested){
    
    temp_df_1 <- do.call("rbind", lapply(sig_DS_df_allMethods_list, function(x){x[[tissue_select]]$ADUEndur}))
    temp_df_2 <- do.call("rbind", lapply(sig_DS_df_allMethods_list, function(x){x[[tissue_select]]$ADUResist}))
    
    temp_sig_ds_gene_list <- list(ADUEndur = unique(temp_df_1$gene_id[temp_df_1$timepoint_select == timepoint_select]),
                                  ADUResist = unique(temp_df_2$gene_id[temp_df_2$timepoint_select == timepoint_select]))
    
    temp_DSgenes_byTime_list[[timepoint_select]] <- temp_sig_ds_gene_list
}


## GO enrichment -----

enrichGO_byTime_list <- list()

for (timepoint_select in names(temp_DSgenes_byTime_list)){

    temp_sig_ds_gene_list <- temp_DSgenes_byTime_list[[timepoint_select]]

    enrichGO_byTime_list[[timepoint_select]][["all"]] <- lapply(temp_sig_ds_gene_list[sapply(temp_sig_ds_gene_list, length) >= 5],
                                                                function(x){
                                                                    enrichGO(gene = x,
                                                                                     universe = unique(gene_info_df$gene_id),
                                                                                     keyType = "ENSEMBL",
                                                                                     OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db, ont = "ALL",
                                                                                     pAdjustMethod = "fdr", pvalueCutoff = 1, qvalueCutoff = 1,
                                                                                     minGSSize = 10, maxGSSize = 500,
                                                                                     readable = TRUE)
                                                                    # enricher(gene = mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db, keys = x, column = "SYMBOL", keytype = "ENSEMBL", multiVals = "first"),
                                                                    #          universe = mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db, keys = unique(gene_info_df$gene_id), column = "SYMBOL", keytype = "ENSEMBL", multiVals = "first"),
                                                                    #          pAdjustMethod = "fdr", pvalueCutoff = 1, qvalueCutoff = 1,
                                                                    #          minGSSize = 10, maxGSSize = 500,
                                                                    #          TERM2GENE = gene_annot_database_df[ProcessLevel == 3, .(ProcessID, Symbol)],
                                                                    #          TERM2NAME = gene_annot_database_df[ProcessLevel == 3, .(ProcessID, ProcessName)])
                                                                })
    
    temp_sig_ds_gene_intersect_list <- attributes(gplots::venn(temp_sig_ds_gene_list, show.plot = F))$intersections
    print(sapply(temp_sig_ds_gene_intersect_list, length))
    
    enrichGO_byTime_list[[timepoint_select]][["intersect"]] <- lapply(temp_sig_ds_gene_intersect_list[sapply(temp_sig_ds_gene_intersect_list, length) >= 5],
                                                                      function(x){
                                                                          enrichGO(gene = x,
                                                                                   universe = unique(gene_info_df$gene_id),
                                                                                   keyType = "ENSEMBL",
                                                                                   OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db, ont = "ALL",
                                                                                   pAdjustMethod = "fdr", pvalueCutoff = 1, qvalueCutoff = 1,
                                                                                   minGSSize = 10, maxGSSize = 500,
                                                                                   readable = TRUE)
                                                                          # enricher(gene = mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db, keys = x, column = "SYMBOL", keytype = "ENSEMBL", multiVals = "first"),
                                                                          #          universe = mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db, keys = unique(gene_info_df$gene_id), column = "SYMBOL", keytype = "ENSEMBL", multiVals = "first"),
                                                                          #          pAdjustMethod = "fdr", pvalueCutoff = 1, qvalueCutoff = 1,
                                                                          #          minGSSize = 10, maxGSSize = 500,
                                                                          #          TERM2GENE = gene_annot_database_df[ProcessLevel == 3, .(ProcessID, Symbol)],
                                                                          #          TERM2NAME = gene_annot_database_df[ProcessLevel == 3, .(ProcessID, ProcessName)])
                                                                      })
}


## simplify GO terms -----

enrichGO_byTime_simplified_list <- list()

for (timepoint_select in names(enrichGO_byTime_list)){
    enrichGO_byTime_simplified_list[[timepoint_select]][["all"]] <- lapply(enrichGO_byTime_list[[timepoint_select]][["all"]], simplify)
    enrichGO_byTime_simplified_list[[timepoint_select]][["intersect"]] <- lapply(enrichGO_byTime_list[[timepoint_select]][["intersect"]], simplify)
```

```{r}
temp_plot_list <- list()
temp_plot_all_df <- list()

for (timepoint_select in names(enrichGO_byTime_simplified_list)){
    
    # All Groups plotted together
    
    temp_GO_df <- do.call("rbind", lapply(names(enrichGO_byTime_simplified_list[[timepoint_select]]$intersect),
                                          function(x){
                                              temp_df <- as.data.frame(enrichGO_byTime_simplified_list[[timepoint_select]]$intersect[[x]])
                                              temp_df$Group <- x
                                              return(temp_df)
                                          }))
    # temp_GO_df$Group <- setNames(c("Endurance specific", "Resistance specific", "Common endurance & resistance"), c("ADUEndur", "ADUResist", "ADUEndur:ADUResist"))[temp_GO_df$Group]
    temp_group_intersect_renaming_vec <- setNames(c("Common EE & RE", "EE specific", "RE specific"), c("ADUEndur:ADUResist", "ADUEndur", "ADUResist"))
    temp_GO_df$Group <- factor(temp_group_intersect_renaming_vec[temp_GO_df$Group], levels = temp_group_intersect_renaming_vec)
    
    temp_terms_select <- Reduce("union", lapply(enrichGO_byTime_simplified_list[[timepoint_select]]$intersect, 
                                                function(x){
                                                    temp_df <- as.data.frame(x)
                                                    temp_df <- temp_df[order(temp_df$p.adjust), ]
                                                    temp_terms <- temp_df[temp_df$p.adjust < 0.1, "Description"]
                                                    return(temp_terms[1:min(8, length(temp_terms))])
                                                }))
    
    temp_plot <- temp_GO_df[temp_GO_df$Description %in% temp_terms_select, ]
    temp_plot <- temp_plot[order(temp_plot$p.adjust), ]
    temp_plot$Description <- stringr::str_wrap(temp_plot$Description, width = 35)
    temp_plot$Description <- factor(temp_plot$Description, levels = rev(unique(temp_plot$Description)))
    
    p1 <- ggplot(temp_plot[temp_plot$p.adjust < 0.05, ]) + 
        geom_point(aes(y = -log10(p.adjust), x = Description, color = Group, size = Count), position = position_dodge(width = 0.4)) + 
        geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.1)) + 
        scale_color_manual(values = setNames(
            # c(annot_colors_use_list$group["Endurance"], annot_colors_use_list$group["Resistance"], "#AAAA11"),
            # c(annot_colors_use_list$group["Endurance"], annot_colors_use_list$group["Resistance"], colorRampPalette(c(annot_colors_use_list$group["Endurance"], annot_colors_use_list$group["Resistance"]))(6)[3]), 
            c(annot_colors_use_list$group["EE"], annot_colors_use_list$group["RE"], colorRampPalette(c(annot_colors_use_list$group["EE"], annot_colors_use_list$group["RE"]))(6)[3]), 
            # c("Endurance specific", "Resistance specific", "Common endurance & resistance"),
            c("EE specific", "RE specific", "Common EE & RE"))) + 
        # scale_size(name = "Count", breaks = c(1, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50), labels = c(1, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50)) + 
        ylim(0, -log10(min(temp_plot$p.adjust))+1) + 
        coord_flip() + 
        theme_minimal() + 
        theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
              legend.title = element_text(size = 12), legend.text = element_text(size = 10)) + 
        guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size=4))) + 
        ggtitle(tissue_select,
                paste0(convert_to_exact_timepoint(timepoint_select, tissue = "muscle")))
    print(p1)
    ggsave(file.path("../results_DS/figs_GO/", paste0("GObyTime-", timepoint_select, "-AllGroup", ".png")), p1, height = 7, width = 6.5)
    ggsave(file.path("../results_DS/figs_GO/", paste0("GObyTime-", timepoint_select, "-AllGroup", ".pdf")), p1, height = 7, width = 6.5)
    ggsave(file.path("../results_DS/figs_GO/", paste0("GObyTime-", timepoint_select, "-AllGroup", ".svg")), p1, height = 7, width = 6.5)
    
    temp_plot_list[[timepoint_select]] <- p1
    
    temp_plot$Tissue <- tissue_select
    temp_plot$Timepoint <- timepoint_select
    temp_plot_all_df[[timepoint_select]] <- temp_plot
}
```

```{r}
# Gather some examples

tissue_select <- "muscle"

# genes DE info
de_gene_df_list <- lapply(dadat, function(x){x[["transcript-rna-seq"]]})
de_gene_df <- de_gene_df_list[[tissue_select]]
de_gene_df$gene_id <- gsub("\\.[0-9]+$", "", de_gene_df$feature_id)

de_gene_df <- setNames(de_gene_df[, c("gene_id", "feature_id", "contrast", "logFC", "p_value", "adj_p_value")],
                       c("gene_id", "gene_feature_id", "contrast", "logFC_gene", "p_value_gene", "adj_p_value_gene"))
    
temp_examples_select_df <- data.frame()

for (exercise_group_select in c("ADUEndur", "ADUResist")){
    
    for (timepoint_select in c("post_15_30_45_min", "post_3.5_4_hr")){
        
        temp_sig_DS_df_allMethods_list <- lapply(sig_DS_df_allMethods_list, function(x){x[[tissue_select]][[exercise_group_select]]})
        temp_sig_DS_df <- do.call("rbind", temp_sig_DS_df_allMethods_list)
        
        
        # Add gene DE info
        control_group_select <- "ADUControl"
        timepoint_baseline <- "pre_exercise"
        da_contrast_string_select <- paste0("group_timepoint", exercise_group_select, ".", timepoint_select, " - ",
                                            "group_timepoint", exercise_group_select, ".", timepoint_baseline, " - ",
                                            "group_timepoint", control_group_select, ".", timepoint_select, " + ",
                                            "group_timepoint", control_group_select, ".", timepoint_baseline)
        temp_df <- merge(temp_sig_DS_df[temp_sig_DS_df$timepoint_select == timepoint_select, ],
                         de_gene_df[de_gene_df$contrast == da_contrast_string_select, c("gene_id", "gene_feature_id", "logFC_gene", "p_value_gene", "adj_p_value_gene")],
                         by = "gene_id", all.x = T)
        temp_df$AS_non_DE <- !is.na(temp_df$adj_p_value_gene) & temp_df$adj_p_value_gene > 0.05
        
        temp_df <- temp_df[temp_df$AS_non_DE, ]
        
        # Add gene ID
        temp_df <- merge(temp_df, MOTRPAC_HUMAN_ENSEMBL_GENE_MAP[, c("ensembl_gene", "gene_symbol")], by.x = "gene_id", by.y = "ensembl_gene", all.x = T)
        
        # Whether region has CDS
        temp_df <- merge(temp_df, sig_feature_info_df[, c("feature", "alt_exon_coords", "alt_exon_has_prt", "inc_exc_tx_prt_diff")], by = "feature", all.x = T)
        
        temp_df <- temp_df[order(temp_df$fdr), ]
        
        
        temp_examples_select_df <- rbind(temp_examples_select_df, 
                                         head(temp_df[abs(temp_df$diff_psi) > 0.15 & temp_df$alt_exon_has_prt,
                                                      c("feature", "fdr", "diff_psi", "gene_symbol", "gene_id", "gene_feature_id", "p_value_gene", "adj_p_value_gene",
                                                        "randomGroupCode", "timepoint_select",
                                                        "alt_exon_coords", "alt_exon_has_prt", "inc_exc_tx_prt_diff", "AS_preprocessing_method")],
                                              20))
    }
}

temp_examples_select_df <- temp_examples_select_df[!duplicated(temp_examples_select_df$feature), ]
temp_examples_select_df <- temp_examples_select_df[!is.na(temp_examples_select_df$gene_symbol), ]

row.names(temp_examples_select_df) <- seq(1, nrow(temp_examples_select_df))

print(table(temp_examples_select_df$AS_preprocessing_method))
print(temp_examples_select_df)
```

```{r}
        # scale_fill_manual(values = annot_colors_use_list$group) +
        scale_fill_manual(values = annot_colors_use_list$timepoint) +
        guides(fill = guide_legend(title = "Timepoint")) + 
        ylab("Gene expression") + 
        theme_minimal() + 
        theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, angle = 315, hjust = 0, vjust = 1),
              strip.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
              plot.margin = margin(2, 30, 2, 2)) + 
        ggtitle(paste0(temp_gene_select, " expression level"))
    # print(p2)
    
    p3 <- p1 + p2 + guide_area() + plot_layout(guides = 'collect', widths = c(1, 1, 0.5))
    print(p3)
    
    ggsave(file.path("../results_DS/figs_example_DS/", paste0(tissue_select, "_", temp_gene_select, "_", temp_feature, ".png")), p3, height = 3, width = 6)
    ggsave(file.path("../results_DS/figs_example_DS/", paste0(tissue_select, "_", temp_gene_select, "_", temp_feature, ".pdf")), p3, height = 3, width = 6)
    ggsave(file.path("../results_DS/figs_example_DS/", paste0(tissue_select, "_", temp_gene_select, "_", temp_feature, ".svg")), p3, height = 3, width = 6)
    
}
```

```{r}
            temp_ref_geneNames <- unique(temp_feature_metadata_df$gene_symbol)

            temp_sig_ref_geneNames <- unique(temp_feature_metadata_df$gene_symbol[temp_feature_metadata_df$id %in% temp_sig_ref_features])

            temp_df_all_ref_modality[[ref_modality_DA]] <- temp_df
        }
        
        
        ref_modality_DA <- "transcript-rna-seq"
        
        da_df_ref <- dadat[[tissue_select]][[ref_modality_DA]]

        temp_ref_geneNames <- MOTRPAC_HUMAN_ENSEMBL_GENE_MAP$gene_symbol[MOTRPAC_HUMAN_ENSEMBL_GENE_MAP$feature_id %in% unique(da_df_ref$feature_id)]
        
        temp_sig_ref_features <- da_df_ref$feature_id[da_df_ref$adj_p_value < 0.05]
        temp_sig_ref_geneNames <- MOTRPAC_HUMAN_ENSEMBL_GENE_MAP$gene_symbol[MOTRPAC_HUMAN_ENSEMBL_GENE_MAP$feature_id %in% temp_sig_ref_features]
        
        # temp_df[[paste0("Avail_in_", ref_modality_DA)]] <- temp_df$gene_symbol %in% temp_ref_geneNames
        # temp_df[[paste0("Sig_in_", ref_modality_DA)]] <- temp_df$gene_symbol %in% temp_sig_ref_geneNames
        
        temp_df$ref_modality_DA <- ref_modality_DA
        temp_df[["Avail"]] <- temp_df$gene_symbol %in% temp_ref_geneNames
        temp_df[["Sig"]] <- temp_df$gene_symbol %in% temp_sig_ref_geneNames
        
        temp_df_all_ref_modality[[ref_modality_DA]] <- temp_df
        
        
        ref_modality_DA <- "AS"
        
        temp_sig_DS_df <- sig_DS_union_df_list[[tissue_select]][[exercise_group_select]][[timepoint_select]]
        temp_sig_DS_df <- merge(temp_sig_DS_df, sig_feature_info_df[, c("feature", "gene_id", "gene_symbol")], by = "feature", all.x = T)
        
        # temp_df[[paste0("Avail_in_", ref_modality_DA)]] <- temp_df[[paste0("Avail_in_", "transcript-rna-seq")]]
        # temp_df[[paste0("Sig_in_", ref_modality_DA)]] <- temp_df$gene_symbol %in% temp_sig_DS_df$gene_symbol
        
        temp_df$ref_modality_DA <- ref_modality_DA
        temp_df[["Avail"]] <- temp_df_all_ref_modality[["transcript-rna-seq"]]$Avail
        temp_df[["Sig"]] <- temp_df$gene_symbol %in% temp_sig_DS_df$gene_symbol
        
        temp_df_all_ref_modality[[ref_modality_DA]] <- temp_df
        
        
        temp_df <- do.call("rbind", temp_df_all_ref_modality)
        
        temp_df_list[[paste0(exercise_group_select, "_", timepoint_select)]] <- temp_df
    }
}
```

```{r}
# read the RBP peaks for each RBP

rbp_to_file_list <- split(encode_eclip_metadata_select_df$File.accession, f = encode_eclip_metadata_select_df$RBP_symbol)


# Keep multiple bed files in a list of GRanges objects for each RBP. Combination of multiple bed profiles is not done here
rbp_gr_original_list <- list()

for (rbp_select in names(rbp_to_file_list)){
    
    temp_grange_list <- list()
    for (file_id in rbp_to_file_list[[rbp_select]]){
        temp_bed_file <- file.path("../../refdata/encode/eCLIP/", paste0(file_id, ".bed.gz"))
        if (file.exists(temp_bed_file)){
            temp_bed <- read.table(temp_bed_file, sep = "\t", header = F)
            temp_gr <- GRanges(seqnames = temp_bed$V1,
                               ranges = IRanges(start = temp_bed$V2,
                                                end = temp_bed$V3),
                               strand = temp_bed$V6)
            temp_grange_list[[file_id]] <- temp_gr
        }
    }
    
    if (length(temp_grange_list) > 0){
        rbp_gr_original_list[[rbp_select]] <- temp_grange_list
    }
}


# combine the multiple bed profiles for the same RBP

rbp_gr_list <- list()

for (rbp_select in names(rbp_gr_original_list)){
    
    temp_grange_list <- rbp_gr_original_list[[rbp_select]]
    
    temp_gr <- reduce(unlist(GRangesList(temp_grange_list)))
    
    rbp_gr_list[[rbp_select]] <- temp_gr
}

temp_widths <- unlist(lapply(rbp_gr_list, width))
hist(temp_widths)
```

## RBP binding overlap

```{r}
tissue_select <- "muscle"
```

```{r}
# Function to get the splice sites as a GRanges from AS feature names
obtain_splice_sites_gr_from_features <- function(features_select, site_window = 250){
    
    features_select_type <- sapply(strsplit(features_select, split = ":"), "[", 1)
    
    # For SE, A5, A3, get all 4 sites
    temp_features <- features_select[features_select_type %in% c("SE", "A5", "A3")]
    
    if (length(temp_features) == 0){
        temp_gr_1 <- NULL
    }else{
        temp_AS_type <- sapply(strsplit(temp_features, ":"), "[", 1)
        temp_chr <- sapply(strsplit(temp_features, ":"), "[", 2)
        temp_strand <- sapply(strsplit(temp_features, ":"), "[", 5)
        temp_coords_list <- lapply(strsplit(temp_features, ":|-"), function(x){unique(strtoi(x[3:6]))})
        temp_coords_vec <- unlist(temp_coords_list)
        temp_coords_length <- sapply(temp_coords_list, length)
        
        temp_gr_1 <- GRanges(seqnames = rep(paste0("chr", temp_chr), times = temp_coords_length),
                             ranges = IRanges(start = unlist(temp_coords_vec) - site_window,
                                              end = unlist(temp_coords_vec) + site_window),
                             strand = rep(temp_strand, times = temp_coords_length),
                             feature = rep(temp_features, times = temp_coords_length),
                             AS_type = rep(temp_AS_type, times = temp_coords_length))
    }
    
    
    # For RI, get the middle 2 sites
    temp_features <- features_select[features_select_type %in% c("RI")]
    
    if (length(temp_features) == 0){
        temp_gr_2 <- NULL
    }else{
        temp_AS_type <- sapply(strsplit(temp_features, ":"), "[", 1)
        temp_chr <- sapply(strsplit(temp_features, ":"), "[", 2)
        temp_strand <- sapply(strsplit(temp_features, ":"), "[", 6)
        temp_coords_list <- lapply(strsplit(temp_features, ":|-"), function(x){unique(strtoi(x[4:5]))})
        temp_coords_vec <- unlist(temp_coords_list)
        temp_coords_length <- sapply(temp_coords_list, length)
        
        temp_gr_2 <- GRanges(seqnames = rep(paste0("chr", temp_chr), times = temp_coords_length),
                             ranges = IRanges(start = unlist(temp_coords_vec) - site_window,
                                              end = unlist(temp_coords_vec) + site_window),
                             strand = rep(temp_strand, times = temp_coords_length),
                             feature = rep(temp_features, times = temp_coords_length),
                             AS_type = rep(temp_AS_type, times = temp_coords_length))
    }
    
    
    return(c(temp_gr_1, temp_gr_2))
}
```

### Enrichment measure

```{r}
# RBP enrichment =====

RBP_site_enrich_df <- list()

for (group_select in names(sig_DS_feature_RBP_mtx_list[[tissue_select]])){
    
    for (timepoint_select in names(sig_DS_feature_RBP_mtx_list[[tissue_select]][[group_select]])){
        
        temp_sig_site_overlap_mtx <- sig_DS_feature_RBP_mtx_list[[tissue_select]][[group_select]][[timepoint_select]]
        
        # Use all features as background
        temp_bg_site_overlap_mtx <- AS_feature_RBP_mtx_bg
        
        # # Use all significant features as background
        # temp_bg_site_overlap_mtx <- AS_feature_RBP_mtx_bg[row.names(AS_feature_RBP_mtx_bg) %in% sig_feature_info_df$feature, ]
        
        ## Enrichment info df =====
        
        temp_enrich_df <- data.table(RBP = colnames(temp_sig_site_overlap_mtx),
                                     row.names = colnames(temp_sig_site_overlap_mtx),
                                     tissue = tissue_select,
                                     group = group_select,
                                     Timepoint_exact = timepoint_select,
                                     Timepoint = timepoint_exact_to_range_vec[timepoint_select])
        
        temp_enrich_df$ratio_sig_site_overlap <- colMeans(temp_sig_site_overlap_mtx)
        temp_enrich_df$ratio_bg_site_overlap <- colMeans(temp_bg_site_overlap_mtx)
        temp_enrich_df$foldchange <- temp_enrich_df$ratio_sig_site_overlap / temp_enrich_df$ratio_bg_site_overlap
        
        temp_enrich_p <- sapply(colnames(temp_sig_site_overlap_mtx),
                                function(x){phyper(q = sum(temp_sig_site_overlap_mtx[, x]),
                                                   m = sum(temp_bg_site_overlap_mtx[, x]),
                                                   n = nrow(temp_bg_site_overlap_mtx) - sum(temp_bg_site_overlap_mtx[, x]),
                                                   k = nrow(temp_sig_site_overlap_mtx),
                                                   lower.tail = F)})
        temp_enrich_df$hypergeom_p <- temp_enrich_p
        temp_enrich_df$hypergeom_fdr <- p.adjust(temp_enrich_df$hypergeom_p, "fdr")
        temp_enrich_df$hypergeom_p_bonferroni <- p.adjust(temp_enrich_df$hypergeom_p, "bonferroni")
        
        # Add ensemble IDs of RBPs
        temp_enrich_df <- merge(temp_enrich_df, setNames(MOTRPAC_HUMAN_ENSEMBL_GENE_MAP[, .(gene_symbol, ensembl_gene)], c("RBP", "RBP_ensembl_id")),
                                by = "RBP", all.x = T)
        
        
        ## Add DA info of RBP from other modalities =====
        
        exercise_group_select <- group_select
        control_group_select <- "ADUControl"
        timepoint_baseline <- "pre_exercise"
        da_contrast_string_select <- paste0("group_timepoint", exercise_group_select, ".", timepoint_exact_to_range_vec[timepoint_select], " - ",
                                            "group_timepoint", exercise_group_select, ".", timepoint_exact_to_range_vec[timepoint_baseline], " - ",
                                            "group_timepoint", control_group_select, ".", timepoint_exact_to_range_vec[timepoint_select], " + ",
                                            "group_timepoint", control_group_select, ".", timepoint_exact_to_range_vec[timepoint_baseline])
        
        
        ### phosphorylated protein -----
        ### Protein -----
        for (ref_modality_DA in c("prot-ph", "prot-pr")) {
            
            da_df_ref <- dadat[[tissue_select]][[ref_modality_DA]]
            da_df_ref <- da_df_ref[da_df_ref$contrast == da_contrast_string_select, ]
            
            temp_feature_metadata_df <- qcdat[[tissue_select]][[ref_modality_DA]]$feature_metadata
            
            # all measured gene symbols
            temp_ref_geneNames <- unique(temp_feature_metadata_df$gene_symbol)
            
            # significant features
            temp_sig_ref_features <- da_df_ref$feature_id[da_df_ref$adj_p_value < 0.05]
            
            temp_sig_ref_feature_metadata_df <- data.table(temp_feature_metadata_df[temp_feature_metadata_df$id %in% temp_sig_ref_features, ])
            temp_sig_ref_feature_metadata_df <- temp_sig_ref_feature_metadata_df[, .(ids = paste0(id, collapse = ", ")), by = .(gene_symbol)]
            
            # significant gene symbols
            temp_sig_ref_geneNames <- setdiff(unique(temp_sig_ref_feature_metadata_df$gene_symbol), NA)
            
            temp_enrich_df[[paste0("Avail_in_", ref_modality_DA)]] <- temp_enrich_df$RBP %in% temp_ref_geneNames
            temp_enrich_df[[paste0("Sig_in_", ref_modality_DA)]] <- temp_enrich_df$RBP %in% temp_sig_ref_geneNames
            
            # Also add the exact feature ID in reference assay
            temp_enrich_df <- merge(temp_enrich_df,
                                    setNames(temp_sig_ref_feature_metadata_df[!(is.na(gene_symbol)) & 
                                                                                  gene_symbol %in% temp_enrich_df$RBP],
                                             c("RBP", paste0("Sig_features_in_", ref_modality_DA))),
                                    by = "RBP", all.x = T)
            print(nrow(temp_enrich_df))
            
        }
        
        
        ### RNA -----
        
        ref_modality_DA <- "transcript-rna-seq"
        
        da_df_ref <- dadat[[tissue_select]][[ref_modality_DA]]
        da_df_ref <- da_df_ref[da_df_ref$contrast == da_contrast_string_select, ]
        
        temp_ref_geneNames <- setdiff(MOTRPAC_HUMAN_ENSEMBL_GENE_MAP$ensembl_gene[MOTRPAC_HUMAN_ENSEMBL_GENE_MAP$feature_id %in% 
                                                                                      unique(da_df_ref$feature_id)],
                                      NA)
        
        temp_sig_ref_features <- da_df_ref$feature_id[da_df_ref$adj_p_value < 0.05]
        temp_sig_ref_geneNames <- setdiff(MOTRPAC_HUMAN_ENSEMBL_GENE_MAP$ensembl_gene[MOTRPAC_HUMAN_ENSEMBL_GENE_MAP$feature_id %in% 
                                                                                          temp_sig_ref_features],
                                          NA)
        
        temp_enrich_df[[paste0("Avail_in_", ref_modality_DA)]] <- temp_enrich_df$RBP_ensembl_id %in% temp_ref_geneNames
        temp_enrich_df[[paste0("Sig_in_", ref_modality_DA)]] <- temp_enrich_df$RBP_ensembl_id %in% temp_sig_ref_geneNames
        
        # for RNA, add direction of change
        da_df_ref <- merge(da_df_ref, MOTRPAC_HUMAN_ENSEMBL_GENE_MAP, by = "feature_id", all.x = T)
        da_df_ref <- da_df_ref[, .(logFC = logFC[which.max(abs(logFC))]), by = .(ensembl_gene)]
        temp_enrich_df <- rbind(merge(temp_enrich_df[temp_enrich_df[[paste0("Avail_in_", ref_modality_DA)]], ],
                                      setNames(da_df_ref[, .(ensembl_gene, logFC)], c("RBP_ensembl_id", paste0("logFC_in_", ref_modality_DA))),
                                      by = "RBP_ensembl_id", all.x = T), 
                                temp_enrich_df[!temp_enrich_df[[paste0("Avail_in_", ref_modality_DA)]], ], fill = T)
        
        
        ### AS changes -----
        ref_modality_DA <- "AS"
        
        temp_ref_geneNames <- unique(unlist(lapply(gene_info_df_allMethods_list[names(sig_DS_df_allMethods_list)],
                                                   function(x){x[event_id %in% 
                                                                     features_test_union_tissue_list[[tissue_select]],
                                                                 gene_id]})))
        temp_ref_geneNames <- ensembl_to_symbol_motrpac(temp_ref_geneNames, ensembl_id_suffix = F)
        
        temp_sig_ref_geneNames <- unique(sig_feature_info_df$gene_symbol)
        
        temp_enrich_df[[paste0("Avail_in_", ref_modality_DA)]] <- temp_enrich_df$RBP %in% temp_ref_geneNames
        temp_enrich_df[[paste0("Sig_in_", ref_modality_DA)]] <- temp_enrich_df$RBP %in% temp_sig_ref_geneNames
        
        # Also add the exact feature ID in reference assay
        temp_sig_ref_feature_metadata_df <- sig_feature_info_df[, .(ids = paste0(feature, collapse = ", ")), 
                                                                by = .(gene_symbol)]
        temp_enrich_df <- merge(temp_enrich_df,
                                setNames(temp_sig_ref_feature_metadata_df[!(is.na(gene_symbol)) & 
                                                                              gene_symbol %in% temp_enrich_df$RBP],
                                         c("RBP", paste0("Sig_features_in_", ref_modality_DA))),
                                by = "RBP", all.x = T)
        
        ## Save =====
        
        RBP_site_enrich_df[[paste0(group_select, "_", timepoint_select)]] <- temp_enrich_df

    }
}

RBP_site_enrich_df <- data.table(do.call("rbind", RBP_site_enrich_df))

RBP_site_enrich_df$Timepoint_exact <- droplevels(factor(RBP_site_enrich_df$Timepoint_exact, levels = timepoints_levels_exact))

# enrichment matrix of RBP across group_timepoint
RBP_site_enrich_df$group_timepoint <- paste0(RBP_site_enrich_df$group, "_", RBP_site_enrich_df$Timepoint)
RBP_enrich_mtx <- reshape2::dcast(RBP_site_enrich_df, RBP ~ group_timepoint, value.var = "hypergeom_p")
row.names(RBP_enrich_mtx) <- RBP_enrich_mtx$RBP
RBP_enrich_mtx$RBP <- NULL
RBP_enrich_mtx <- -log10(RBP_enrich_mtx)
```
