## RBP phos - AS feature pair - Correlation across individual

```{r}
# splicing_preprocess_method_select <- "SUPPA"
# splicing_preprocess_method_select <- "rMATS"

RBP_feature_cor_df <- list()

diff_PSI_pid_mtx_all_AllMethods <- list()


for (splicing_preprocess_method_select in c("SUPPA", "rMATS")){


# Get PSI table ==========

# A list by tissue, for each tissue, a list of PSI tables
AS_psi_table_tissue_list <- lapply(AS_object_qcdat, function(x){x[[paste0("AS-", splicing_preprocess_method_select)]]$AS_psi_table})
print(lapply(AS_psi_table_tissue_list, ncol))

# keep features that are not NA for all samples
AS_psi_table_tissue_list <- lapply(AS_psi_table_tissue_list, function(x){x[rowSums(is.na(x)) < ncol(x), ]})
print(sapply(AS_psi_table_tissue_list, ncol))

# keep samples that are not NA for all features
AS_psi_table_tissue_list <- lapply(AS_psi_table_tissue_list, function(x){x[, colSums(is.na(x)) < nrow(x)]})
print(sapply(AS_psi_table_tissue_list, ncol))



# Diff PSI calculation ===========
# For each group and timepoint, find the subjects with both pre and post exercise, calculate the PSI diff
# Then find the subjects with the ref modality (prot-ph, prot-pr, or others) and

# splicing_preprocess_method_select <- "SUPPA"
variable_confounding <- c("BMI", "calculatedAge","Sex")

tissue_select <- "muscle"
AS_psi_table <- AS_psi_table_tissue_list[[tissue_select]]

diff_PSI_pid_mtx_list <- list()

for (exercise_group_select in c("ADUEndur", "ADUResist")){
    
    # select tissue and exercise group
    sample_metadata_df_select <- sample_metadata_df[sample_metadata_df$sampleGroupCode == tissue_name_mapping[tissue_select] & 
                                                        sample_metadata_df$randomGroupCode == exercise_group_select, ]
    
    # Select time points that are available for this exercise group
    temp_sample_number_table <- table(sample_metadata_df_select$Timepoint)
    timepoints_available <- names(temp_sample_number_table)[temp_sample_number_table >= 5]
    
    # Set baseline time point
    timepoint_baseline <- "pre_exercise"
    if (!(timepoint_baseline %in% timepoints_available)){ next }
    timepoints_exercise <- setdiff(timepoints_available, timepoint_baseline)
    
    
    # Time point contrasts
    for (timepoint_select in timepoints_exercise){
        
        print(paste(tissue_select, exercise_group_select, ":", timepoint_select, "-", timepoint_baseline))
        
        # subject level meta data
        temp_df <- sample_metadata_df_select[sample_metadata_df_select$Timepoint %in% c(timepoint_baseline, timepoint_select), ]
        temp_df$pid <- as.character(temp_df$pid)
        subjects_select <- names(table(temp_df$pid))[table(temp_df$pid) == 2]
        print(length(subjects_select))
        
        temp_df <- data.table(temp_df[temp_df$pid %in% subjects_select, ])
        subject_metadata_df_select <- temp_df[, .(sample_ID_Visit1 = vialLabel[Timepoint == timepoint_baseline],
                                                  sample_ID_Visit2 = vialLabel[Timepoint == timepoint_select]), 
                                              by = c("pid", variable_confounding)]
        
        
        # diff PSI matrix
        diff_PSI_select_table <- AS_psi_table[, subject_metadata_df_select$sample_ID_Visit2] - AS_psi_table[, subject_metadata_df_select$sample_ID_Visit1]
        colnames(diff_PSI_select_table) <- paste0(exercise_group_select, "_", timepoint_select, "_", subject_metadata_df_select$pid)
        
        # Calculate only on the significant features
        diff_PSI_select_table <- diff_PSI_select_table[row.names(diff_PSI_select_table) %in% sig_feature_info_df$feature, ]
        
        # Score for calculating RBP activity
        temp_feature_score_mtx <- as.matrix(diff_PSI_select_table)
        
        diff_PSI_pid_mtx_list[[paste0(exercise_group_select, "_", timepoint_select)]] <- temp_feature_score_mtx
    }
}

temp_features_intersect <- Reduce("intersect", lapply(diff_PSI_pid_mtx_list, row.names))

diff_PSI_pid_mtx_all <- do.call("cbind", lapply(diff_PSI_pid_mtx_list, function(x){x[temp_features_intersect, ]}))
print(dim(diff_PSI_pid_mtx_all))

diff_PSI_pid_mtx_all_AllMethods[[splicing_preprocess_method_select]] <- diff_PSI_pid_mtx_all



# RBP activity in ref assay ==========
# Check the RBP activity in ref modality

ref_modality_DA <- "prot-ph"

diff_RBP_pid_table_list <- list()

for (exercise_group_select in c("ADUEndur", "ADUResist")){
    
    # select tissue and exercise group
    sample_metadata_df_select <- sample_metadata_df[sample_metadata_df$sampleGroupCode == tissue_name_mapping[tissue_select] & 
                                                        sample_metadata_df$randomGroupCode == exercise_group_select, ]
    
    # Select time points that are available for this exercise group
    temp_sample_number_table <- table(sample_metadata_df_select$Timepoint)
    timepoints_available <- names(temp_sample_number_table)[temp_sample_number_table >= 5]
    
    # Set baseline time point
    timepoint_baseline <- "pre_exercise"
    if (!(timepoint_baseline %in% timepoints_available)){ next }
    timepoints_exercise <- setdiff(timepoints_available, timepoint_baseline)
    
    
    # Time point contrasts
    for (timepoint_select in timepoints_exercise){
        
        temp_sample_metadata_df <- qcdat[[tissue_select]][[ref_modality_DA]]$sample_metadata
        
        # See if the ref modality has this group and time point
        # control_group_select <- "ADUControl"
        # da_contrast_string_select <- paste0("group_timepoint", exercise_group_select, ".", timepoint_select, " - ",
        #                                     "group_timepoint", exercise_group_select, ".", timepoint_baseline, " - ",
        #                                     "group_timepoint", control_group_select, ".", timepoint_select, " + ",
        #                                     "group_timepoint", control_group_select, ".", timepoint_baseline)
        
        
        # subject level meta data
        temp_df <- temp_sample_metadata_df[temp_sample_metadata_df$sampleGroupCode == tissue_name_mapping[tissue_select] & 
                                               temp_sample_metadata_df$randomGroupCode == exercise_group_select & 
                                               temp_sample_metadata_df$Timepoint %in% c(timepoint_baseline, timepoint_select), ]
        if(nrow(temp_df) == 0){ next }
        temp_df$pid <- as.character(temp_df$pid)
        subjects_select <- names(table(temp_df$pid))[table(temp_df$pid) == 2]
        # print(length(subjects_select))
        if(length(subjects_select) == 0){ next }
        
        temp_df <- data.table(temp_df[temp_df$pid %in% subjects_select, ])
        subject_metadata_df_select <- temp_df[, .(sample_ID_Visit1 = vialLabel[Timepoint == timepoint_baseline],
                                                  sample_ID_Visit2 = vialLabel[Timepoint == timepoint_select]), 
                                              by = c("pid", variable_confounding)]
        
        
        # diff RBP matrix
        temp_qc_mtx <- qcdat[[tissue_select]][[ref_modality_DA]]$qc_norm
        diff_RBP_pid_table <- log2(temp_qc_mtx[, as.character(subject_metadata_df_select$sample_ID_Visit2)] / temp_qc_mtx[, as.character(subject_metadata_df_select$sample_ID_Visit1)])
        colnames(diff_RBP_pid_table) <- subject_metadata_df_select$pid
        # print(dim(diff_RBP_pid_table))
        
        # Only look at RBP
        temp_feature_metadata_df <- qcdat[[tissue_select]][[ref_modality_DA]]$feature_metadata
        diff_RBP_pid_table <- diff_RBP_pid_table[row.names(diff_RBP_pid_table) %in% temp_feature_metadata_df$id[temp_feature_metadata_df$gene_symbol %in% colnames(AS_feature_RBP_mtx_bg)], ]
        
        colnames(diff_RBP_pid_table) <- paste0(exercise_group_select, "_", timepoint_select, "_", colnames(diff_RBP_pid_table))
        
        
        diff_RBP_pid_table_list[[paste0(exercise_group_select, "_", timepoint_select)]] <- as.matrix(diff_RBP_pid_table)
        
    }
}

print(sapply(diff_RBP_pid_table_list, dim))

diff_RBP_pid_table_all <- do.call("cbind", diff_RBP_pid_table_list)
print(dim(diff_RBP_pid_table_all))



# Correlation calculation ==========
# correlation across individuals, all timepoints combined

# temp_feature_metadata_df <- temp_feature_metadata_df[temp_feature_metadata_df$gene_symbol %in% row.names(diff_RBP_pid_table_all), ]

# Common pid_timepoint samples
temp_group_timepoint_pid <- intersect(colnames(diff_PSI_pid_mtx_all), colnames(diff_RBP_pid_table_all))
print(length(temp_group_timepoint_pid))


# Correlation between RBP phopsphorylation and individual feature
temp_cor <- psych::corr.test(t(diff_RBP_pid_table_all[, temp_group_timepoint_pid]), t(diff_PSI_pid_mtx_all[, temp_group_timepoint_pid]),
                             use = "pairwise", method="pearson", adjust = "holm", ci = F)

temp_cor_p_df <- as.data.frame(temp_cor$p)
temp_cor_p_df$RBP_phos_id <- row.names(temp_cor_p_df)
temp_cor_p_df <- reshape2::melt(temp_cor_p_df, id.vars = c("RBP_phos_id"), variable.name = "AS_feature", value.name = "cor_p")

temp_cor_r_df <- as.data.frame(temp_cor$r)
temp_cor_r_df$RBP_phos_id <- row.names(temp_cor_r_df)
temp_cor_r_df <- reshape2::melt(temp_cor_r_df, id.vars = c("RBP_phos_id"), variable.name = "AS_feature", value.name = "cor_r")

temp_cor_p_df$temp_id <- paste0(temp_cor_p_df$RBP_phos_id, "_", temp_cor_p_df$AS_feature)
temp_cor_r_df$temp_id <- paste0(temp_cor_r_df$RBP_phos_id, "_", temp_cor_r_df$AS_feature)

temp_cor_p_df <- merge(temp_cor_p_df, temp_cor_r_df[, c("temp_id", "cor_r")], all = T)
temp_cor_p_df$temp_id <- NULL

temp_cor_p_df$AS_feature <- as.character(temp_cor_p_df$AS_feature)


# Add RBP phosphorylation id to gene symbol mapping
temp_feature_metadata_df <- qcdat[[tissue_select]][[ref_modality_DA]]$feature_metadata
temp_df <- temp_feature_metadata_df[temp_feature_metadata_df$id %in% row.names(diff_RBP_pid_table_all), 
                                    c("id", "gene_symbol")]
temp_cor_p_df <- merge(temp_cor_p_df, setNames(temp_df[, c("id", "gene_symbol")], c("RBP_phos_id", "RBP_symbol")), 
                       by = "RBP_phos_id", all.x = T)
temp_cor_p_df <- data.table(temp_cor_p_df)


# Only filter for RBP - AS pairs where the RBP has a binding site to the AS
AS_feature_RBP_mtx_bg_list <- sapply(colnames(AS_feature_RBP_mtx_bg),
                                     function(x){row.names(AS_feature_RBP_mtx_bg)[AS_feature_RBP_mtx_bg[, x] > 0]}, 
                                     simplify = F, USE.NAMES = T)
AS_feature_RBP_mtx_bg_list <- AS_feature_RBP_mtx_bg_list[sapply(AS_feature_RBP_mtx_bg_list, length) > 0]
temp_RBP_feature_pairs <- unlist(sapply(names(AS_feature_RBP_mtx_bg_list), 
                                        function(x){paste0(x, "_", AS_feature_RBP_mtx_bg_list[[x]])}))

temp_cor_p_df <- temp_cor_p_df[paste0(RBP_symbol, "_", AS_feature) %in% temp_RBP_feature_pairs, ]
print(nrow(temp_cor_p_df))

hist(temp_cor_p_df$cor_p)

# adjust p values
temp_cor_p_df <- temp_cor_p_df[order(cor_p, na.last = T), ]
temp_cor_p_df$cor_p_adj <- p.adjust(temp_cor_p_df$cor_p, "fdr")

temp_cor_p_sig_df <- temp_cor_p_df[!is.na(cor_p_adj) & cor_p_adj < 0.05, ]
print(nrow(temp_cor_p_sig_df))
print(table(temp_cor_p_sig_df$RBP_symbol))


temp_cor_p_sig_df$AS_method <- splicing_preprocess_method_select


RBP_feature_cor_df[[splicing_preprocess_method_select]] <- temp_cor_p_sig_df

}


RBP_feature_cor_df <- do.call("rbind", RBP_feature_cor_df)
```

```{r}
rbp_select <- "SERBP1"

temp_cor_select_df <- as.data.frame(RBP_feature_cor_df[RBP_symbol == rbp_select, ])


for(i in seq(1, nrow(temp_cor_select_df))){
    
    rbp_id_select <- temp_cor_select_df[i, "RBP_phos_id"]
    temp_as_feature_select <- as.character(temp_cor_select_df[i, "AS_feature"])
    
    temp_AS_method <- temp_cor_select_df[i, "AS_method"]
    
    temp_as_gene_select <- sig_feature_info_df$gene_symbol[sig_feature_info_df$feature == temp_as_feature_select]
    
    # intersection of subjects with both diff PSI and diff RBP reference
    diff_PSI_pid_mtx_all <- diff_PSI_pid_mtx_all_AllMethods[[temp_AS_method]]
    temp_group_timepoint_pid <- intersect(colnames(diff_PSI_pid_mtx_all), colnames(diff_RBP_pid_table_all))
    
    temp_plot_df <- data.frame(group_timepoint_pid = temp_group_timepoint_pid,
                               diff_PSI = diff_PSI_pid_mtx_all[temp_as_feature_select, temp_group_timepoint_pid],
                               diff_RBP = diff_RBP_pid_table_all[rbp_id_select, temp_group_timepoint_pid])
    
    temp <- strsplit(temp_plot_df$group_timepoint_pid, "_")
    temp_plot_df$Group <- sapply(temp, "[", 1)
    temp_plot_df$Timepoint <- sapply(temp, function(x){paste0(x[2:(length(x)-1)], collapse = "_")}, simplify = T)
    temp_plot_df$pid <- sapply(temp, function(x){x[length(x)]}, simplify = T)
    
    temp_plot_df$Timepoint_exact <- convert_to_exact_timepoint(temp_plot_df$Timepoint, tissue = "muscle")
    temp_plot_df$Timepoint_exact <- droplevels(factor(timepoint_renaming_vector[as.character(temp_plot_df$Timepoint_exact)], levels = timepoint_renaming_vector))
    
    temp_plot_df$Group <- droplevels(factor(group_renaming_vector[as.character(temp_plot_df$Group)], levels = group_renaming_vector))
    
    p1 <- ggplot(temp_plot_df, aes(x = diff_RBP, y = diff_PSI)) + 
        geom_point(aes(color = Timepoint_exact, shape = Group)) + 
        scale_color_manual(values = annot_colors_use_list$timepoint[unique(as.character(temp_plot_df$Timepoint_exact))]) +
        geom_smooth(method='lm', formula= y~x) + 
        xlab(paste0("RBP phosphorylation fold change\n", rbp_select, " (", rbp_id_select, ")")) + 
        ylab(paste0("AS feature PSI change\n", temp_as_gene_select, " (", temp_as_feature_select, ")")) + 
        guides(color = guide_legend(title = "Timepoint")) + 
        ggtitle(paste0(rbp_select, " - ", temp_as_gene_select),
                paste0("cor = ", format(cor(temp_plot_df$diff_PSI, temp_plot_df$diff_RBP, use = "pairwise"), digits = 2), " p = ", format(temp_cor_select_df[i, "cor_p"], digits = 2))) + 
        theme_minimal() + 
        theme(legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
              legend.text = element_text(size = 12))
    print(p1)
    
    ggsave(file.path("../results_RBP/RBP-phos-AS-feature_cor_plots/", 
                     paste0("Cor_", rbp_select, "-", rbp_id_select, "_", temp_as_gene_select, "-", temp_as_feature_select, "_", temp_AS_method, ".png")), 
           p1, width = 5, height = 4)
    ggsave(file.path("../results_RBP/RBP-phos-AS-feature_cor_plots/", 
                     paste0("Cor_", rbp_select, "-", rbp_id_select, "_", temp_as_gene_select, "-", temp_as_feature_select, "_", temp_AS_method, ".pdf")), 
           p1, width = 5, height = 4)
    ggsave(file.path("../results_RBP/RBP-phos-AS-feature_cor_plots/", 
                     paste0("Cor_", rbp_select, "-", rbp_id_select, "_", temp_as_gene_select, "-", temp_as_feature_select, "_", temp_AS_method, ".svg")), 
           p1, width = 5, height = 4)
}
```

```{r}
# Function for generating matching feature-by-sample matrices where the samples are named by subject_timepoint so they are matched at the participant and timepoint levels

generate_matching_data <- function(tissue_select, splicing_preprocess_method_select, venn_plot = F){
    
    # Matching data from different modalities ==========
    
    # AS matrix by tissue
    
    # Split into tissue groups
    # A list by tissue, for each tissue, a list of PSI tables by AS type
    AS_psi_table_tissue_list <- lapply(AS_object_qcdat, function(x){x[[paste0("AS-", splicing_preprocess_method_select)]]$AS_psi_table})
    print(sapply(AS_psi_table_tissue_list, ncol))
    
    # keep features that are not NA for all samples
    AS_psi_table_tissue_list <- lapply(AS_psi_table_tissue_list, function(x){x[rowSums(is.na(x)) < ncol(x), ]})
    print(sapply(AS_psi_table_tissue_list, ncol))
    
    # keep samples that are not NA for all features
    AS_psi_table_tissue_list <- lapply(AS_psi_table_tissue_list, function(x){x[, colSums(is.na(x)) < nrow(x)]})
    print(sapply(AS_psi_table_tissue_list, ncol))
    
    
    
    # Feature (RNA or AS) matrix and ATAC matrix with matching colnames by subject and timepoint matching
    
    ## AS matrix =====
    feature_mtx <- as.matrix(AS_psi_table_tissue_list[[tissue_select]])
    print(dim(feature_mtx))
    
    # get sample meta data corresponding to this modality
    feature_sample_meta_df <- qcdat[[tissue_select]]$`transcript-rna-seq`$sample_metadata
    feature_sample_meta_df$vialLabel <- as.character(feature_sample_meta_df$vialLabel)
    feature_sample_meta_df <- feature_sample_meta_df[feature_sample_meta_df$vialLabel %in% colnames(feature_mtx), , drop = F]
    
    # Add ID for matching between Features and ATAC
    feature_sample_meta_df$cross_match_id <- paste0(feature_sample_meta_df$pid, "_", feature_sample_meta_df$Timepoint)
    print(paste("No duplicate samples for each cross_match_id:", length(unique(feature_sample_meta_df$cross_match_id)) == length(unique(feature_sample_meta_df$vialLabel))))
    row.names(feature_sample_meta_df) <- feature_sample_meta_df$cross_match_id
    
    # order the meta data by their order in the matrix
    feature_sample_meta_df <- feature_sample_meta_df[match(colnames(feature_mtx), feature_sample_meta_df$vialLabel), ]
    
    # rename the samples names of the feature_mtx to the cross_match_id
    colnames(feature_mtx) <- setNames(feature_sample_meta_df$cross_match_id, feature_sample_meta_df$vialLabel)[colnames(feature_mtx)]
    
    Matching_AS_mtx <- feature_mtx
    Matching_AS_mtx_sample_meta_df <- feature_sample_meta_df
    
    
    
    ## RNA matrix =====
    feature_mtx <- as.matrix(qcdat[[tissue_select]]$`transcript-rna-seq`$qc_norm)
    print(dim(feature_mtx))
    
    # get sample meta data corresponding to this modality
    feature_sample_meta_df <- qcdat[[tissue_select]]$`transcript-rna-seq`$sample_metadata
    feature_sample_meta_df$vialLabel <- as.character(feature_sample_meta_df$vialLabel)
    feature_sample_meta_df <- feature_sample_meta_df[feature_sample_meta_df$vialLabel %in% colnames(feature_mtx), , drop = F]
    
    # Add ID for matching between Features and ATAC
    feature_sample_meta_df$cross_match_id <- paste0(feature_sample_meta_df$pid, "_", feature_sample_meta_df$Timepoint)
    print(paste("No duplicate samples for each cross_match_id:", length(unique(feature_sample_meta_df$cross_match_id)) == length(unique(feature_sample_meta_df$vialLabel))))
    row.names(feature_sample_meta_df) <- feature_sample_meta_df$cross_match_id
    
    # order the meta data by their order in the matrix
    feature_sample_meta_df <- feature_sample_meta_df[match(colnames(feature_mtx), feature_sample_meta_df$vialLabel), ]
    
    # rename the samples names of the feature_mtx to the cross_match_id
    colnames(feature_mtx) <- setNames(feature_sample_meta_df$cross_match_id, feature_sample_meta_df$vialLabel)[colnames(feature_mtx)]
    
    Matching_RNA_mtx <- feature_mtx
    Matching_RNA_mtx_sample_meta_df <- feature_sample_meta_df
    
    
    
    ## ATAC matrix =====
    
    ATAC_mtx <- as.matrix(qcdat[[tissue_select]]$`epigen-atac-seq`$qc_norm)
    print(dim(ATAC_mtx))
    
    # get sample meta data corresponding to this modality
    ATAC_sample_meta_df <- qcdat[[tissue_select]]$`epigen-atac-seq`$sample_metadata
    ATAC_sample_meta_df$vialLabel <- as.character(ATAC_sample_meta_df$vialLabel)
    ATAC_sample_meta_df <- ATAC_sample_meta_df[ATAC_sample_meta_df$vialLabel %in% colnames(ATAC_mtx), , drop = F]
    
    # Add ID for matching between Features and ATAC
    ATAC_sample_meta_df$cross_match_id <- paste0(ATAC_sample_meta_df$pid, "_", ATAC_sample_meta_df$Timepoint)
    print(paste("No duplicate samples for each cross_match_id:", length(unique(ATAC_sample_meta_df$cross_match_id)) == length(unique(ATAC_sample_meta_df$vialLabel))))
    row.names(ATAC_sample_meta_df) <- ATAC_sample_meta_df$cross_match_id
    
    # order the meta data by their order in the matrix
    ATAC_sample_meta_df <- ATAC_sample_meta_df[match(colnames(ATAC_mtx), ATAC_sample_meta_df$vialLabel), ]
    
    # rename the samples name of the ATAC_mtx to the cross_match_id
    colnames(ATAC_mtx) <- setNames(ATAC_sample_meta_df$cross_match_id, ATAC_sample_meta_df$vialLabel)[colnames(ATAC_mtx)]
    
    Matching_ATAC_mtx <- ATAC_mtx
    Matching_ATAC_mtx_sample_meta_df <- ATAC_sample_meta_df
    
    
    
    ## Matching samples =====
    if (venn_plot){
        gplots::venn(list(AS = colnames(Matching_AS_mtx),
                          RNA = colnames(Matching_RNA_mtx),
                          ATAC = colnames(Matching_ATAC_mtx)))
    }
    
    return(list(Matching_AS_mtx = Matching_AS_mtx,
                Matching_AS_mtx_sample_meta_df = Matching_AS_mtx_sample_meta_df,
                Matching_RNA_mtx = Matching_RNA_mtx, 
                Matching_RNA_mtx_sample_meta_df = Matching_RNA_mtx_sample_meta_df,
                Matching_ATAC_mtx = Matching_ATAC_mtx,
                Matching_ATAC_mtx_sample_meta_df = Matching_ATAC_mtx_sample_meta_df))
    
}
```

```{r}
tissue_select <- "muscle"

scRNA_read_count_matrix <- Matching_AS_mtx

Gene_chr=character(length(Gene_symbols))
Gene_TSS=integer(length(Gene_symbols))
Candidate_Genes=data.frame(Gene_symbols, Gene_chr, Gene_TSS)
colnames(Candidate_Genes) = c("Gene_symbols", "chr", "TSS")
for (g in 1:length(Gene_symbols)){
    index = which(Refseq$Gene_symbols==Candidate_Genes$Gene_symbols[g])
    Candidate_Genes$chr[g] <- Refseq$chr[index[1]]
    if (Refseq$strand[index[1]]=='+'){
        Candidate_Genes$TSS[g] <- min(Refseq$start[index])
    }else{
        Candidate_Genes$TSS[g] <- max(Refseq$end[index])
    }
}


# Peak-Gene looping
Candidate_Peak_Gene_looping_distance_control=sparseMatrix(i=1,j=1,x=0, dims=c(nrow(Candidate_Peaks), nrow(Candidate_Genes)), repr = "T")
for (g in 1:length(Candidate_Genes$Gene_symbols)){
    index=which(Candidate_Peaks$chr==Candidate_Genes$chr[g] & abs((Candidate_Peaks$point1+Candidate_Peaks$point2)/2-Candidate_Genes$TSS[g])<distance_control)
    if (length(index)>0){
        Candidate_Peak_Gene_looping_distance_control[index,g]=1
    }
}
Candidate_Peak_Gene_looping<-Candidate_Peak_Gene_looping_distance_control
Peak_index<-which(rowSums(Candidate_Peak_Gene_looping)>0)
Gene_index<-which(colSums(Candidate_Peak_Gene_looping)>0)
Candidate_Peak_Gene_looping<-Candidate_Peak_Gene_looping[Peak_index,Gene_index]
Candidate_Peaks<-Candidate_Peaks[Peak_index,]
Candidate_Genes<-Candidate_Genes[Gene_index,]
TF_index=which(colSums(Candidate_TF_Peak_Binding[Peak_index,])>0)
Candidate_TFs=Candidate_TFs[TF_index,]
Candidate_TF_Peak_Binding=Candidate_TF_Peak_Binding[Peak_index, TF_index]


#pseudobulk ATAC data is calculated for model initialization
ATAC_count=matrix(0,nrow=nrow(scATAC_read_count_matrix), ncol=length(Common_samples))
for (s in 1:length(Common_samples)){
    # ATAC_count[,s]=rowSums(scATAC_read_count_matrix[,which(scATAC_cells$subject_ID==Common_samples[s]), drop = F])
    ATAC_count[,s]=rowMeans(scATAC_read_count_matrix[,which(scATAC_cells$subject_ID==Common_samples[s]), drop = F]) # Since this is bulk data, no need to calculated pseudobulk
}
colnames(ATAC_count)<-Common_samples
rownames(ATAC_count)<-scATAC_Peaks$Peak_index

# total_ATAC_reads=5e6
# ATAC_scale_facter=total_ATAC_reads/(colSums(ATAC_count)+1)
# ATAC_count=sweep(ATAC_count, 2, ATAC_scale_facter, "*")
# ATAC_log2=log2(ATAC_count+1)
ATAC_log2 <- ATAC_count # Since this is bulk data, no need to calculated pseudobulk

index=match(Candidate_Peaks$Peak_index, scATAC_Peaks$Peak_index)
Candidate_Peak_log2Count=ATAC_log2[index,]
Candidate_Peak_log2Count=sweep(Candidate_Peak_log2Count, 1, rowMeans(Candidate_Peak_log2Count), '-')


#pseudobulk RNA data is calculated for model initialization
RNA_count=matrix(0,nrow=nrow(scRNA_read_count_matrix), ncol=length(Common_samples))
for (s in 1:length(Common_samples)){
    # RNA_count[,s]=rowSums(scRNA_read_count_matrix[,which(scRNA_cells$subject_ID==Common_samples[s]), drop = F])
    RNA_count[,s]=rowMeans(scRNA_read_count_matrix[,which(scRNA_cells$subject_ID==Common_samples[s]), drop = F]) # Since this is bulk data, no need to calculated pseudobulk
}
colnames(RNA_count)<-Common_samples
rownames(RNA_count)<-scRNA_Genes$Gene_symbols

# total_RNA_reads=5e6
# RNA_scale_facter=total_RNA_reads/(colSums(RNA_count)+1)
# RNA_count=sweep(RNA_count, 2, RNA_scale_facter, "*")
# RNA_log2=log2(RNA_count+1)
RNA_log2 <- RNA_count # Since this is bulk data, no need to calculated pseudobulk

index=match(Candidate_Genes$Gene_symbols, scRNA_Genes$Gene_symbols)
Candidate_Gene_log2Count=RNA_log2[index,]
Candidate_Gene_log2Count=sweep(Candidate_Gene_log2Count, 1, rowMeans(Candidate_Gene_log2Count), '-')


# TFs that are not expressed in the current data are not considered
selected_TFs=intersect(Candidate_TFs$name, scRNA_Genes$Gene_symbols)
index=match(selected_TFs, Candidate_TFs$name)
Candidate_TFs=Candidate_TFs[index,]
Candidate_TF_Peak_Binding=Candidate_TF_Peak_Binding[,index]

index=match(selected_TFs, scRNA_Genes$Gene_symbols)
Candidate_TF_log2Count=RNA_log2[index,]

TF_index=which(rowSums(Candidate_TF_log2Count)>0)
Candidate_TFs=Candidate_TFs[TF_index,]
Candidate_TF_Peak_Binding=Candidate_TF_Peak_Binding[,TF_index]
Candidate_TF_log2Count=Candidate_TF_log2Count[TF_index,]
Candidate_TF_log2Count=sweep(Candidate_TF_log2Count, 1, rowMeans(Candidate_TF_log2Count), '-')


# final filtering for candidate circuits
Peak_index=which(rowSums(Candidate_Peak_Gene_looping)>0 & rowSums(Candidate_TF_Peak_Binding)>0)
Gene_index=which(colSums(Candidate_Peak_Gene_looping[Peak_index,])>0)
TF_index=which(colSums(Candidate_TF_Peak_Binding[Peak_index,])>0)

Candidate_TF_Peak_Binding=Candidate_TF_Peak_Binding[Peak_index,TF_index]
Candidate_Peak_Gene_looping=Candidate_Peak_Gene_looping[Peak_index,Gene_index]

Candidate_TFs=Candidate_TFs[TF_index,]
Candidate_TF_log2Count=Candidate_TF_log2Count[TF_index,]

Candidate_Peaks=Candidate_Peaks[Peak_index,]
Candidate_Peak_log2Count=Candidate_Peak_log2Count[Peak_index,]  

Candidate_Genes=Candidate_Genes[Gene_index,]
Candidate_Gene_log2Count=Candidate_Gene_log2Count[Gene_index,]

Candidate_circuits=list('TFs'=Candidate_TFs, 
                        'TF_log2Count'=Candidate_TF_log2Count,
                        'Peaks'=Candidate_Peaks, 
                        'Peak_log2Count'=Candidate_Peak_log2Count,
                        'Genes'=Candidate_Genes, 
                        'Gene_log2Count'=Candidate_Gene_log2Count,
                        'TF_Peak_Binding'=Candidate_TF_Peak_Binding, 
                        'Peak_Gene_looping'=Candidate_Peak_Gene_looping)

# MAGICAL: Run ==========

## Initialize -----

Initial_model <- MAGICAL_initialization(loaded_data, Candidate_circuits)

## Estimation -----

Circuits_linkage_posterior <- MAGICAL_estimation(loaded_data, Candidate_circuits, Initial_model, iteration_num = 1000)


## Save -----

MAGICAL_circuits_output(Output_file_path = file.path("../results_SRC/by_tissue-group-timepoint/",
                                                     paste0("MAGICAL-splicing_selected_regulatory_circuits_", 
                                                            splicing_preprocess_method_select, "_", tissue_select, "-", exercise_group_select, "-", timepoint_select, ".txt")),
                        Candidate_circuits, Circuits_linkage_posterior)

saveRDS(list(Candidate_circuits = Candidate_circuits,
             Circuits_linkage_posterior = Circuits_linkage_posterior),
        file.path("../results_SRC/by_tissue-group-timepoint/",
                  paste0("MAGICAL-splicing_Circuits_linkage_candidates-and-posterior_", 
                         splicing_preprocess_method_select, "_", tissue_select, "-", exercise_group_select, "-", timepoint_select, ".rds")))


# # Output the MAGICAL results
# return(list(Candidate_circuits = Candidate_circuits,
#             Circuits_linkage_posterior = Circuits_linkage_posterior,
#             splicing_preprocess_method_select = splicing_preprocess_method_select,
#             tissue_select = tissue_select,
#             exercise_group_select = exercise_group_select,
#             timepoint_select = timepoint_select))

}
```

## MAGICAL RUN - accompanying GRC

```{r}
tissue_select <- "muscle"
tissue_group_time_combination_df <- expand.grid(c("post_15_30_45_min", "post_3.5_4_hr", "post_24_hr"), c("ADUEndur", "ADUResist"), c(tissue_select))
colnames(tissue_group_time_combination_df) <- c("Timepoint", "Group", "Tissue")

tissue_group_time_combination_df <- as.data.frame(lapply(tissue_group_time_combination_df, as.character))



# Select the exercise group and timepoint
temp_ind <- 1

for (temp_ind in seq(1, nrow(tissue_group_time_combination_df))){
    
    # Select the exercise group and timepoint
    tissue_select <- tissue_group_time_combination_df[temp_ind, "Tissue"]
    exercise_group_select <- tissue_group_time_combination_df[temp_ind, "Group"]
    timepoint_select <- tissue_group_time_combination_df[temp_ind, "Timepoint"]
    
    print(paste(tissue_group_time_combination_df[temp_ind, ], collapse = ", "))
    
    
    
# Matching data from different modalities ==========

temp <- generate_matching_data(tissue_select = tissue_select, splicing_preprocess_method_select = splicing_preprocess_method_select)

Matching_AS_mtx <- temp$Matching_AS_mtx
Matching_AS_mtx_sample_meta_df <- temp$Matching_AS_mtx_sample_meta_df
Matching_RNA_mtx <- temp$Matching_RNA_mtx
Matching_RNA_mtx_sample_meta_df <- temp$Matching_RNA_mtx_sample_meta_df
Matching_ATAC_mtx <- temp$Matching_ATAC_mtx
Matching_ATAC_mtx_sample_meta_df <- temp$Matching_ATAC_mtx_sample_meta_df





# MAGICAL: Data loading ==========


# da contrast string for selected group and time point
control_group_select <- "ADUControl"
timepoint_baseline <- "pre_exercise"
da_contrast_string_select <- paste0("group_timepoint", exercise_group_select, ".", timepoint_select, " - ",
                                    "group_timepoint", exercise_group_select, ".", timepoint_baseline, " - ",
                                    "group_timepoint", control_group_select, ".", timepoint_select, " + ",
                                    "group_timepoint", control_group_select, ".", timepoint_baseline)



## candidate Genes and Peaks in the selected tissue, group, timepoint combination -----

Candidate_Genes <- unique(sig_DS_union_df_list[[tissue_select]][[exercise_group_select]][[timepoint_select]]$feature)
Candidate_Genes <- Reduce("union", lapply(gene_info_df_allMethods_list, function(gene_info_df){gene_info_df$gene_id[gene_info_df$event_id %in% Candidate_Genes]}))
Candidate_Genes <- data.frame(Gene_symbols = Candidate_Genes)
print(nrow(Candidate_Genes))


p_val_cutoff <- 5e-3

temp_da_df <- dadat[[tissue_select]]$`epigen-atac-seq`
Candidate_Peaks <- unique(temp_da_df$feature_id[temp_da_df$p_value < p_val_cutoff & 
                                                    temp_da_df$contrast == da_contrast_string_select])
Candidate_Peaks <- strsplit(as.character(Candidate_Peaks), split = ":|-")
Candidate_Peaks <- data.frame(chr = sapply(Candidate_Peaks, "[", 1),
                              point1 = strtoi(sapply(Candidate_Peaks, "[", 2)),
                              point2 = strtoi(sapply(Candidate_Peaks, "[", 3)))
print(nrow(Candidate_Peaks))



## load TF motif prior -----

# Load Peak - TF matrix first because need to know the TFs involved, then need to include the RNA levels of those TFs to the splicing data matrix, because TF RNAs are used in the prior

# See [integrative_analysis.Rmd] "# Peak - TF motif matrix" section for the calculation of TF-peak binding matrix in the MoTrPAC data

TF_Peak_binding_matrix <- readRDS("../data_processed_objects/TF_Peak_binding_matrix_ensembl-id.rds")

# Remove ensemble ID subffix to be consistent with the gene IDs from AS features
colnames(TF_Peak_binding_matrix) <- gsub("\\.[0-9]+", "", colnames(TF_Peak_binding_matrix))

Motifs <- data.frame(motif_index = seq(1, ncol(TF_Peak_binding_matrix)),
                     name = colnames(TF_Peak_binding_matrix))



## load scRNAseq data -----

scRNA_read_count_matrix <- Matching_RNA_mtx

# Remove ensemble ID subffix to be consistent with the gene IDs from AS features
row.names(scRNA_read_count_matrix) <- gsub("\\.[0-9]+", "", row.names(scRNA_read_count_matrix))

scRNA_Genes <- data.frame(Gene_index = seq(1, nrow(scRNA_read_count_matrix)),
                          Gene_symbols = row.names(scRNA_read_count_matrix))
colnames(scRNA_Genes) <- c("Gene_index", "Gene_symbols")


scRNA_cells <- Matching_RNA_mtx_sample_meta_df
scRNA_cells <- scRNA_cells[scRNA_cells$cross_match_id %in% colnames(scRNA_read_count_matrix), ]
scRNA_cells$cell_index <- match(scRNA_cells$cross_match_id, colnames(scRNA_read_count_matrix))
scRNA_cells$cell_type <- scRNA_cells$Tissue
scRNA_cells$subject_id <- scRNA_cells$cross_match_id
scRNA_cells$condition <- paste0(scRNA_cells$randomGroupCode, "_", scRNA_cells$Timepoint)
scRNA_cells <- scRNA_cells[order(scRNA_cells$cell_index), c("cell_index", "vialLabel", "cell_type", "subject_id", "condition")]
colnames(scRNA_cells) <- c("cell_index", "cell_barcode", "cell_type", "subject_ID", "condition")


scRNA_read_count_matrix <- as(scRNA_read_count_matrix, "TsparseMatrix")
row.names(scRNA_read_count_matrix) <- seq(1, nrow(scRNA_read_count_matrix))
colnames(scRNA_read_count_matrix) <- seq(1, ncol(scRNA_read_count_matrix))


scRNA_samples = unique(scRNA_cells$subject_ID)


Group_conditions = unique(scRNA_cells$condition)



## load scATACseq data -----

scATAC_read_count_matrix <- Matching_ATAC_mtx

scATAC_Peaks <- data.frame(feature_id = row.names(Matching_ATAC_mtx))
scATAC_Peaks$Peak_index <- match(scATAC_Peaks$feature_id, row.names(scATAC_read_count_matrix))
scATAC_Peaks_tempstrsplit <- strsplit(scATAC_Peaks$feature_id, split = ":|-")
scATAC_Peaks$chr <- sapply(scATAC_Peaks_tempstrsplit, "[", 1)
scATAC_Peaks$point1 <- strtoi(sapply(scATAC_Peaks_tempstrsplit, "[", 2))
scATAC_Peaks$point2 <- strtoi(sapply(scATAC_Peaks_tempstrsplit, "[", 3))
scATAC_Peaks <- scATAC_Peaks[order(scATAC_Peaks$Peak_index), c("Peak_index", "chr", "point1", 'point2')]
colnames(scATAC_Peaks) <- c("Peak_index", "chr", "point1", 'point2')

scATAC_cells <- Matching_ATAC_mtx_sample_meta_df
scATAC_cells$cell_index <- match(scATAC_cells$cross_match_id, colnames(scATAC_read_count_matrix))
scATAC_cells$cell_type <- scATAC_cells$Tissue
scATAC_cells$subject_id <- scATAC_cells$cross_match_id
scATAC_cells <- scATAC_cells[order(scATAC_cells$cell_index), c("cell_index", "vialLabel", "cell_type", "subject_id")]
colnames(scATAC_cells) <-  c("cell_index", "cell_barcode", "cell_type", 'subject_ID')

scATAC_read_count_matrix <- as(scATAC_read_count_matrix, "TsparseMatrix")
row.names(scATAC_read_count_matrix) <- seq(1, nrow(scATAC_read_count_matrix))
colnames(scATAC_read_count_matrix) <- seq(1, ncol(scATAC_read_count_matrix))


scATAC_samples = unique(scATAC_cells$subject_ID) 


# Filter Peak-TF binding matrix to these ATAC peaks
TF_Peak_binding_matrix <- TF_Peak_binding_matrix[paste0(scATAC_Peaks$chr, ":", scATAC_Peaks$point1, "-", scATAC_Peaks$point2), ]



## Common samples -----

Common_samples=intersect(scRNA_samples, scATAC_samples)
print(paste('There are sample-paired single cell multiomics data for', length(Common_samples), 'samples.', sep = ' '))
print('Please check sample IDs if this number is lower than expected.')
cat('\n')




## load RefSeq -----

Ref_seq_file_path <- "../../magical_crema/tools/MAGICAL_demo_input/hg38_Refseq.txt"

Refseq <- read.table(Ref_seq_file_path, header = TRUE, sep='\t')

# Add ensembl_id
Refseq <- merge(Refseq, setNames(MOTRPAC_HUMAN_ENSEMBL_GENE_MAP[, c("feature_id", "gene_symbol")], c("Gene_symbols", "gene_name")), all = F)
Refseq$gene_name <- NULL

Refseq$Gene_symbols <- gsub("\\.[0-9]+", "", Refseq$Gene_symbols)

Refseq <- Refseq[, c("chr", "strand", "start", "end", "Gene_symbols")]

colnames(Refseq) = c("chr", "strand", "start", "end", "Gene_symbols")




## Loaded data object -----
loaded_data = list('Common_samples'=Common_samples, 
                   'Candidate_Genes'=Candidate_Genes, 
                   'Candidate_Peaks'=Candidate_Peaks,
                   'scRNA_Genes'=scRNA_Genes,
                   'scRNA_cells'=scRNA_cells,
                   'scRNA_read_count_matrix'=scRNA_read_count_matrix,
                   'scATAC_Peaks'=scATAC_Peaks, 
                   'scATAC_cells'=scATAC_cells,
                   'scATAC_read_count_matrix'=scATAC_read_count_matrix,
                   'Motifs'=Motifs, 
                   'TF_Peak_binding_matrix'=TF_Peak_binding_matrix,

# MAGICAL: Candidate circuits ==========

distance_control <- 3e5

Common_samples=loaded_data$Common_samples
Candidate_Genes=loaded_data$Candidate_Genes
Candidate_Peaks=loaded_data$Candidate_Peaks
scRNA_Genes=loaded_data$scRNA_Genes 
scRNA_cells=loaded_data$scRNA_cells 
scRNA_read_count_matrix=loaded_data$scRNA_read_count_matrix
scATAC_Peaks=loaded_data$scATAC_Peaks 
scATAC_cells=loaded_data$scATAC_cells

Motifs=loaded_data$Motifs 
TF_Peak_binding_matrix=loaded_data$TF_Peak_binding_matrix

#**********load TAD prior**********
print(paste('Naive pairing of peaks and genes if they are within', distance_control,'bps', sep = ' '))
cat('\n')

cat('\n')

# TF-Peak binding
Candidate_Peaks<-inner_join(scATAC_Peaks, Candidate_Peaks)
index<-match(Candidate_Peaks$Peak_index, scATAC_Peaks$Peak_index)
Candidate_TF_Peak_Binding<-TF_Peak_binding_matrix[index,]
TF_num<-colSums(Candidate_TF_Peak_Binding)
TF_pct_in_candidate_Peaks<-colSums(Candidate_TF_Peak_Binding)/nrow(Candidate_Peaks)
TF_pct_in_all_Peaks<-colSums(TF_Peak_binding_matrix)/nrow(scATAC_Peaks)
TF_enrichment_FC<-TF_pct_in_candidate_Peaks/TF_pct_in_all_Peaks
TF_index<-which(TF_pct_in_candidate_Peaks>0.05 & TF_num>30 & TF_enrichment_FC>0.8)
if (length(TF_index) == 0){
    print('Too few Peaks with TF binding sites.')
    print('MAGICAL not applicable to this cell type!')
}else{
    Candidate_TFs <- Motifs[TF_index,]
    Candidate_TF_Peak_Binding <- Candidate_TF_Peak_Binding[,TF_index]
}
Peak_index<-which(rowSums(Candidate_TF_Peak_Binding)>0)
Candidate_Peaks <- Candidate_Peaks[Peak_index,]
Candidate_TF_Peak_Binding <- Candidate_TF_Peak_Binding[Peak_index,]


# extract Gene TSS
Gene_symbols<-intersect(intersect(Candidate_Genes$Gene_symbols, Refseq$Gene_symbols), scRNA_Genes$Gene_symbols)

Gene_TSS=integer(length(Gene_symbols))
Candidate_Genes=data.frame(Gene_symbols, Gene_chr, Gene_TSS)
colnames(Candidate_Genes) = c("Gene_symbols", "chr", "TSS")
for (g in 1:length(Gene_symbols)){
    index = which(Refseq$Gene_symbols==Candidate_Genes$Gene_symbols[g])
    Candidate_Genes$chr[g] <- Refseq$chr[index[1]]
    if (Refseq$strand[index[1]]=='+'){
        Candidate_Genes$TSS[g] <- min(Refseq$start[index])
    }else{
        Candidate_Genes$TSS[g] <- max(Refseq$end[index])
    }
}


# Peak-Gene looping
Candidate_Peak_Gene_looping_distance_control=sparseMatrix(i=1,j=1,x=0, dims=c(nrow(Candidate_Peaks), nrow(Candidate_Genes)), repr = "T")
for (g in 1:length(Candidate_Genes$Gene_symbols)){
    index=which(Candidate_Peaks$chr==Candidate_Genes$chr[g] & abs((Candidate_Peaks$point1+Candidate_Peaks$point2)/2-Candidate_Genes$TSS[g])<distance_control)
    if (length(index)>0){
        Candidate_Peak_Gene_looping_distance_control[index,g]=1
    }
}
Candidate_Peak_Gene_looping<-Candidate_Peak_Gene_looping_distance_control
Peak_index<-which(rowSums(Candidate_Peak_Gene_looping)>0)
Gene_index<-which(colSums(Candidate_Peak_Gene_looping)>0)
Candidate_Peak_Gene_looping<-Candidate_Peak_Gene_looping[Peak_index,Gene_index]
Candidate_Peaks<-Candidate_Peaks[Peak_index,]
Candidate_Genes<-Candidate_Genes[Gene_index,]
TF_index=which(colSums(Candidate_TF_Peak_Binding[Peak_index,])>0)
Candidate_TFs=Candidate_TFs[TF_index,]
Candidate_TF_Peak_Binding=Candidate_TF_Peak_Binding[Peak_index, TF_index]


#pseudobulk ATAC data is calculated for model initialization
ATAC_count=matrix(0,nrow=nrow(scATAC_read_count_matrix), ncol=length(Common_samples))
for (s in 1:length(Common_samples)){
    # ATAC_count[,s]=rowSums(scATAC_read_count_matrix[,which(scATAC_cells$subject_ID==Common_samples[s]), drop = F])
    ATAC_count[,s]=rowMeans(scATAC_read_count_matrix[,which(scATAC_cells$subject_ID==Common_samples[s]), drop = F]) # Since this is bulk data, no need to calculated pseudobulk
}
colnames(ATAC_count)<-Common_samples
rownames(ATAC_count)<-scATAC_Peaks$Peak_index

# total_ATAC_reads=5e6
# ATAC_scale_facter=total_ATAC_reads/(colSums(ATAC_count)+1)
# ATAC_count=sweep(ATAC_count, 2, ATAC_scale_facter, "*")
# ATAC_log2=log2(ATAC_count+1)
ATAC_log2 <- ATAC_count # Since this is bulk data, no need to calculated pseudobulk

index=match(Candidate_Peaks$Peak_index, scATAC_Peaks$Peak_index)
Candidate_Peak_log2Count=ATAC_log2[index,]
Candidate_Peak_log2Count=sweep(Candidate_Peak_log2Count, 1, rowMeans(Candidate_Peak_log2Count), '-')


#pseudobulk RNA data is calculated for model initialization
RNA_count=matrix(0,nrow=nrow(scRNA_read_count_matrix), ncol=length(Common_samples))
for (s in 1:length(Common_samples)){
    # RNA_count[,s]=rowSums(scRNA_read_count_matrix[,which(scRNA_cells$subject_ID==Common_samples[s]), drop = F])
    RNA_count[,s]=rowMeans(scRNA_read_count_matrix[,which(scRNA_cells$subject_ID==Common_samples[s]), drop = F]) # Since this is bulk data, no need to calculated pseudobulk
}
colnames(RNA_count)<-Common_samples
rownames(RNA_count)<-scRNA_Genes$Gene_symbols

# total_RNA_reads=5e6
# RNA_scale_facter=total_RNA_reads/(colSums(RNA_count)+1)
# RNA_count=sweep(RNA_count, 2, RNA_scale_facter, "*")
# RNA_log2=log2(RNA_count+1)
RNA_log2 <- RNA_count # Since this is bulk data, no need to calculated pseudobulk

index=match(Candidate_Genes$Gene_symbols, scRNA_Genes$Gene_symbols)
Candidate_Gene_log2Count=RNA_log2[index,]
Candidate_Gene_log2Count=sweep(Candidate_Gene_log2Count, 1, rowMeans(Candidate_Gene_log2Count), '-')


# TFs that are not expressed in the current data are not considered
selected_TFs=intersect(Candidate_TFs$name, scRNA_Genes$Gene_symbols)
index=match(selected_TFs, Candidate_TFs$name)
Candidate_TFs=Candidate_TFs[index,]
Candidate_TF_Peak_Binding=Candidate_TF_Peak_Binding[,index]

index=match(selected_TFs, scRNA_Genes$Gene_symbols)
Candidate_TF_log2Count=RNA_log2[index,]

TF_index=which(rowSums(Candidate_TF_log2Count)>0)
Candidate_TFs=Candidate_TFs[TF_index,]
Candidate_TF_Peak_Binding=Candidate_TF_Peak_Binding[,TF_index]
Candidate_TF_log2Count=Candidate_TF_log2Count[TF_index,]
Candidate_TF_log2Count=sweep(Candidate_TF_log2Count, 1, rowMeans(Candidate_TF_log2Count), '-')


# final filtering for candidate circuits
Peak_index=which(rowSums(Candidate_Peak_Gene_looping)>0 & rowSums(Candidate_TF_Peak_Binding)>0)
Gene_index=which(colSums(Candidate_Peak_Gene_looping[Peak_index,])>0)
TF_index=which(colSums(Candidate_TF_Peak_Binding[Peak_index,])>0)

Candidate_TF_Peak_Binding=Candidate_TF_Peak_Binding[Peak_index,TF_index]
Candidate_Peak_Gene_looping=Candidate_Peak_Gene_looping[Peak_index,Gene_index]

Candidate_TFs=Candidate_TFs[TF_index,]
Candidate_TF_log2Count=Candidate_TF_log2Count[TF_index,]

Candidate_Peaks=Candidate_Peaks[Peak_index,]
Candidate_Peak_log2Count=Candidate_Peak_log2Count[Peak_index,]  

Candidate_Genes=Candidate_Genes[Gene_index,]
Candidate_Gene_log2Count=Candidate_Gene_log2Count[Gene_index,]

Candidate_circuits=list('TFs'=Candidate_TFs, 
                        'TF_log2Count'=Candidate_TF_log2Count,
                        'Peaks'=Candidate_Peaks, 
                        'Peak_log2Count'=Candidate_Peak_log2Count,
                        'Genes'=Candidate_Genes, 
                        'Gene_log2Count'=Candidate_Gene_log2Count,
                        'TF_Peak_Binding'=Candidate_TF_Peak_Binding, 
                        'Peak_Gene_looping'=Candidate_Peak_Gene_looping)



# MAGICAL: Run ==========

# source("../../magical_crema/tools/magical/R/MAGICAL_functions.R")
library(magical)

## Initialize -----

Initial_model <- MAGICAL_initialization(loaded_data, Candidate_circuits)

## Estimation -----

Circuits_linkage_posterior <- MAGICAL_estimation(loaded_data, Candidate_circuits, Initial_model, iteration_num = 1000)

## Save -----

MAGICAL_circuits_output(Output_file_path = file.path("../results_SRC/accompanying-GRC_by_tissue-group-timepoint_run-in-R/", 
                                                     paste0("MAGICAL-splicing-GRC_selected_regulatory_circuits_", tissue_select, "-", exercise_group_select, "-", timepoint_select, ".txt")),
                        Candidate_circuits, Circuits_linkage_posterior)

saveRDS(list(Candidate_circuits = Candidate_circuits,
             Circuits_linkage_posterior = Circuits_linkage_posterior),
        file.path("../results_SRC/accompanying-GRC_by_tissue-group-timepoint_run-in-R/", 
                  paste0("MAGICAL-splicing-GRC_Circuits_linkage_candidates-and-posterior_", tissue_select, "-", exercise_group_select, "-", timepoint_select, ".rds")))
    
}
```

```{r}
tissue_select <- "muscle"

for (splicing_preprocess_method_select in c("rMATS", "SUPPA")){
    
    for (temp_ind in seq(1, nrow(tissue_group_time_combination_df))){
        
        tissue_select <- tissue_group_time_combination_df[temp_ind, "Tissue"]
        exercise_group_select <- tissue_group_time_combination_df[temp_ind, "Group"]
        timepoint_select <- tissue_group_time_combination_df[temp_ind, "Timepoint"]
        
        temp_file <- file.path("../results_SRC/by_tissue-group-timepoint_run-in-R-newRlibrary/",
                               paste0("MAGICAL-splicing_selected_regulatory_circuits_", splicing_preprocess_method_select, "_", tissue_select, "-", exercise_group_select, "-", timepoint_select, ".txt"))
        if (!file.exists(temp_file)){ next }
        MAGICAL_circuits_df_temp <- read.table(temp_file, sep = "\t", header = T)
        
        MAGICAL_circuits_df_temp$AS_method <- splicing_preprocess_method_select
        
        
        colnames(MAGICAL_circuits_df_temp)[1:3] <- c("Feature", "Feature_chr", "Feature_TSS")
        
        # Add AS feature strand
        MAGICAL_circuits_df_temp$Feature_strand <- ifelse(sapply(strsplit(MAGICAL_circuits_df_temp$Feature, ":|-"), "[", 7) == "+", yes = "+", no = "-")
        
        
        # Add peak coordinates as a string
        MAGICAL_circuits_df_temp$peak_str <- paste0(MAGICAL_circuits_df_temp$Peak_chr, ":", MAGICAL_circuits_df_temp$Peak_start, "-", MAGICAL_circuits_df_temp$Peak_end)

        # Add gene info for the splicing features
        gene_info_df <- gene_info_df_allMethods_list[[splicing_preprocess_method_select]]
        MAGICAL_circuits_df_temp <- merge(MAGICAL_circuits_df_temp, gene_info_df[, c("event_id", "gene_id")], by.x = "Feature", by.y = "event_id", all.x = T)
        
        # Add gene symbol
        temp_df <- setNames(MOTRPAC_HUMAN_ENSEMBL_GENE_MAP[, c("ensembl_gene", "gene_symbol", "feature_id")], 
                            c("ensembl_gene", "gene_symbol", "gene_id_in_qcdat"))
        MAGICAL_circuits_df_temp <- merge(MAGICAL_circuits_df_temp, temp_df, by.x = "gene_id", by.y = "ensembl_gene", all.x = T)

        MAGICAL_circuits_df_list[[paste0(splicing_preprocess_method_select, "_", temp_ind)]] <- MAGICAL_circuits_df_temp
    }
    
}
```

```{r}
MAGICAL_circuits_selected_df <- list()

for (tissue_select in c("muscle")){
    
    temp_groups_select <- names(sig_DS_union_df_list[[tissue_select]])
    temp_timepoints_select <- Reduce("union", lapply(sig_DS_union_df_list[[tissue_select]], names))
    
    temp_groups_select <- intersect(exercise_groups, temp_groups_select)
    temp_timepoints_select <- intersect(timepoints_levels, temp_timepoints_select)
    
    for (group_select in temp_groups_select){
        
        for(timepoint_select in temp_timepoints_select){
            
            temp_diff_features <- sig_DS_union_df_list[[tissue_select]][[group_select]][[timepoint_select]]$feature
            
            # # remove AS events with DE gene
            # temp_da_df <- dadat[[tissue_select]]$`transcript-rna-seq`
            # temp_diff_genes <- unique(temp_da_df$feature_id[temp_da_df$p_value < 0.05 & 
            #                                                     # # abs(temp_da_df$logFC) > 0.25 & 
            #                                                     temp_da_df$contrast1_randomGroupCode == group_select &
            #                                                     temp_da_df$contrast1_timepoint == timepoint_select
            # ])
            # temp_diff_genes <- gsub("\\.[0-9]+$", "", temp_diff_genes)
            # temp_diff_features <- setdiff(temp_diff_features, gene_info_df$event_id[gene_info_df$gene_id %in% temp_diff_genes])
            # # END remove AS events with DE gene
            
            if (length(temp_diff_features) == 0){ next }
            
            exercise_group_select <- group_select            
            control_group_select <- "ADUControl"
            timepoint_baseline <- "pre_exercise"
            da_contrast_string_select <- paste0("group_timepoint", exercise_group_select, ".", timepoint_select, " - ",
                                                "group_timepoint", exercise_group_select, ".", timepoint_baseline, " - ",
                                                "group_timepoint", control_group_select, ".", timepoint_select, " + ",
                                                "group_timepoint", control_group_select, ".", timepoint_baseline)
            
            temp_da_df <- dadat[[tissue_select]]$`epigen-atac-seq`
            temp_diff_peaks <- temp_da_df$feature_id[temp_da_df$contrast == da_contrast_string_select & temp_da_df$p_value < 5e-3]
            if (length(temp_diff_peaks) == 0){ next }
            
            
            temp_circuits_df <- MAGICAL_circuits_full_df[Feature %in% temp_diff_features & peak_str %in% temp_diff_peaks, ]
            if (nrow(temp_circuits_df) == 0){ next }
            
            
            # Add group and timepoint info
            temp_circuits_df$Tissue <- tissue_select
            temp_circuits_df$Group <- group_select
            temp_circuits_df$Timepoint <- timepoint_select
            
            
            # temp_circuits_df$Target <- temp_circuits_df$Feature
            # 
            # # TF-peak-target table
            # temp_tfs_list <- lapply(strsplit(temp_circuits_df$TFs.binding.prob., split = ","), 
            #                         function(x){x[seq(1, length(x), 2)]})
            # temp_tfs_binding_probs_list <- lapply(strsplit(temp_circuits_df$TFs.binding.prob., split = ","),
            #                                       function(x){setNames(as.numeric(gsub("\\(|\\)", "", x[seq(2, length(x), 2)])), 
            #                                                            x[seq(1, length(x), 2)])})
            # temp_circuits_df$TFs.binding.prob. <- NULL
            # temp_circuits_df <- temp_circuits_df[rep(seq(1, nrow(temp_circuits_df)), times = sapply(temp_tfs_list, length))]
            # temp_circuits_df$TF <- unlist(temp_tfs_list)
            # temp_circuits_df$TF_binding_prob <- unlist(temp_tfs_binding_probs_list)
            
            
            ### Add DA info from other modalities -----
            control_group_select <- "ADUControl"
            timepoint_baseline <- "pre_exercise"
            da_contrast_string_select <- paste0("group_timepoint", exercise_group_select, ".", timepoint_select, " - ",
                                                "group_timepoint", exercise_group_select, ".", timepoint_baseline, " - ",
                                                "group_timepoint", control_group_select, ".", timepoint_select, " + ",
                                                "group_timepoint", control_group_select, ".", timepoint_baseline)
            
            for (ref_modality_DA in c("prot-ph", "prot-pr")) {
                
                da_df_ref <- dadat[[tissue_select]][[ref_modality_DA]]
                da_df_ref <- da_df_ref[da_df_ref$contrast == da_contrast_string_select, ]
                
                temp_feature_metadata_df <- qcdat[[tissue_select]][[ref_modality_DA]]$feature_metadata
                
                # all measured gene symbols
                temp_ref_geneNames <- unique(temp_feature_metadata_df$gene_symbol)
                
                # significant features
                temp_sig_ref_features <- da_df_ref$feature_id[da_df_ref$adj_p_value < 0.05]
                
                temp_sig_ref_feature_metadata_df <- data.table(temp_feature_metadata_df[temp_feature_metadata_df$id %in% temp_sig_ref_features, ])
                temp_sig_ref_feature_metadata_df <- temp_sig_ref_feature_metadata_df[, .(ids = paste0(id, collapse = ", ")), by = .(gene_symbol)]
                
                # significant gene symbols
                temp_sig_ref_geneNames <- unique(temp_feature_metadata_df$gene_symbol[temp_feature_metadata_df$id %in% temp_sig_ref_features])
                
                temp_circuits_df[[paste0("Avail_in_", ref_modality_DA)]] <- temp_circuits_df$TF %in% temp_ref_geneNames
                temp_circuits_df[[paste0("Sig_in_", ref_modality_DA)]] <- temp_circuits_df$TF %in% temp_sig_ref_geneNames
                
                # Also add the exact feature ID in phosphorylation assay
                temp_circuits_df <- merge(temp_circuits_df,
                                          setNames(temp_sig_ref_feature_metadata_df[!(is.na(gene_symbol)) & gene_symbol %in% temp_circuits_df$TF],
                                                   c("TF", paste0("Sig_features_in_", ref_modality_DA))),
                                          by = "TF", all.x = T)
            }
            
            
            ### RNA -----
            
            ref_modality_DA <- "transcript-rna-seq"
            
            da_df_ref <- dadat[[tissue_select]][[ref_modality_DA]]
            da_df_ref <- da_df_ref[da_df_ref$contrast == da_contrast_string_select, ]
            
            temp_ref_geneNames <- unique(MOTRPAC_HUMAN_ENSEMBL_GENE_MAP$gene_symbol[MOTRPAC_HUMAN_ENSEMBL_GENE_MAP$feature_id %in% unique(da_df_ref$feature_id)])
            
            temp_sig_ref_features <- da_df_ref$feature_id[da_df_ref$adj_p_value < 0.05]
            temp_sig_ref_geneNames <- unique(MOTRPAC_HUMAN_ENSEMBL_GENE_MAP$gene_symbol[MOTRPAC_HUMAN_ENSEMBL_GENE_MAP$feature_id %in% temp_sig_ref_features])
            
            temp_circuits_df[[paste0("Avail_in_", ref_modality_DA)]] <- temp_circuits_df$TF %in% temp_ref_geneNames
            temp_circuits_df[[paste0("Sig_in_", ref_modality_DA)]] <- temp_circuits_df$TF %in% temp_sig_ref_geneNames
            
            
            MAGICAL_circuits_selected_df[[paste0(tissue_select, "-", group_select, "-", timepoint_select)]] <- temp_circuits_df
            
        }
    }
}

MAGICAL_circuits_selected_df <- do.call("rbind", MAGICAL_circuits_selected_df)

MAGICAL_circuits_selected_df$Timepoint <- droplevels(factor(MAGICAL_circuits_selected_df$Timepoint, levels = timepoints_levels))
MAGICAL_circuits_selected_df$Group <- droplevels(factor(MAGICAL_circuits_selected_df$Group, levels = exercise_groups))

MAGICAL_circuits_selected_df$AS_type <- factor(sapply(strsplit(MAGICAL_circuits_selected_df$Feature, ":"), "[", 1), levels = AS_types)
```

```{r}
                         by = .(TF)]

                                                                         yes = "Measured, not significant", no = "Not measured")
    temp_plot_y[[paste0("ref_result_", temp_ref_modality_DA)]] <- ifelse(temp_plot_y[[paste0("Sig_in_", temp_ref_modality_DA)]], 
                                                                         yes = "Measured, significant", no = temp_plot_y[[paste0("ref_result_", temp_ref_modality_DA)]])

    #                                                                      levels = c("Not measured", "Measured, not significant", "Measured, significant"))
}

                               Phos_protein = `ref_result_prot-ph`,
                               Protein = `ref_result_prot-pr`,
                               RNA = `ref_result_transcript-rna-seq`)]

temp_ref_assay_to_show <- c("Significant", "Not measured")

temp_plot_y[["Reference assay"]] <- factor(temp_ref_assay_levels[temp_plot_y[["Reference assay"]]], 
                                           levels = unique(temp_ref_assay_levels))

# RBP protein has no significance, don't plot

p_y <- ggplot(temp_plot_y) + 
    geom_tile(aes(y = TF, x = Ref_assay, fill = .data[["Reference assay"]]), color = "#555555") +
    # scale_fill_manual(values = setNames(c("#222222", "#999999", "#FFFFFF"), levels(temp_plot_y[["Reference assay"]]))) + 
    scale_fill_manual(values = setNames(c("#222222", "#FFFFFF", "#FFFFFF"), levels(temp_plot_y[["Reference assay"]])),
                      breaks = temp_ref_assay_to_show) +

    # # scale_pattern_spacing_manual(values = c(0, 0)) + 
    geom_point(aes(y = TF, x = Ref_assay, 
                   size = .data[["Reference assay"]],
                   color = .data[["Reference assay"]]), shape = 4) + 
    scale_size_manual(values = setNames(c(0, 0, 3), levels(temp_plot_y[["Reference assay"]])),
                      breaks = temp_ref_assay_to_show) +
    scale_color_manual(values = setNames(c("#FFFFFF00", "#FFFFFF00", "#222222"), levels(temp_plot_y[["Reference assay"]])),
                       breaks = temp_ref_assay_to_show) +
    xlab("Reference assay") +
    # xlab("") + scale_x_discrete(position = "top") +

    theme(
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, angle = 315, hjust = 0, vjust = 1),

    )
```

```{r}
ref_modality_DA <- "prot-ph"

temp_ref_modality_qc <- as.matrix(qcdat[[tissue_select]][[ref_modality_DA]]$qc_norm)
temp_ref_modality_sample_meta_df <- qcdat[[tissue_select]][[ref_modality_DA]]$sample_metadata
temp_ref_modality_feature_meta_df <- qcdat[[tissue_select]][[ref_modality_DA]]$feature_metadata
colnames(temp_ref_modality_qc) <- setNames(paste0(temp_ref_modality_sample_meta_df$pid, "_", temp_ref_modality_sample_meta_df$Timepoint), temp_ref_modality_sample_meta_df$vialLabel)[colnames(temp_ref_modality_qc)]

i <- which(temp_AS_peak_df$Feature == "SE:14:60249677-60250380:60250481-60282684:+")


temp_plot_df <- Matching_AS_mtx_sample_meta_df[Matching_AS_mtx_sample_meta_df$cross_match_id %in% common_samples,
                                               c("cross_match_id", "Timepoint", "randomGroupCode", "sampleGroupCode", "Sex")]
temp_plot_df <- add_exact_timepoint(temp_plot_df, tissue_col = "sampleGroupCode", tissue_name_mapping = tissue_name_mapping, timepoint_col = "Timepoint")

temp_plot_df$Timepoint_new <- droplevels(factor(timepoint_renaming_vector[as.character(temp_plot_df$Timepoint_exact)], 
                                                levels = timepoint_renaming_vector))

temp_feature <- as.character(temp_AS_peak_df$Feature[i])
temp_gene_id_in_qcdat <- as.character(temp_AS_peak_df$gene_id_in_qcdat[i])
temp_gene_symbol <- as.character(temp_AS_peak_df$gene_symbol[i])
temp_peak <- as.character(temp_AS_peak_df$peak_str[i])

# Add AS PSI, gene expression and peak accesibility
temp_plot_df$AS_feature <- Matching_AS_mtx[temp_feature, temp_plot_df$cross_match_id]
temp_plot_df$gene_RNA <- Matching_RNA_mtx[temp_gene_id_in_qcdat, temp_plot_df$cross_match_id]
temp_plot_df$regulatory_peak <- Matching_ATAC_mtx[temp_peak, temp_plot_df$cross_match_id]

temp_plot_df <- temp_plot_df[temp_plot_df$randomGroupCode == exercise_group_select, ]

temp_cor_AS_peak <- cor.test(temp_plot_df$AS_feature, temp_plot_df$regulatory_peak, method = "pearson")
temp_cor_gene_peak <- cor.test(temp_plot_df$gene_RNA, temp_plot_df$regulatory_peak, method = "pearson")

# correlation plot
p1 <- ggplot(temp_plot_df, aes(x = regulatory_peak, y = AS_feature)) + 
    geom_point(aes(color = Timepoint_new)) + 
    scale_color_manual(values = annot_colors_use_list$timepoint[unique(as.character(temp_plot_df$Timepoint_new))]) +
    # facet_grid(. ~ randomGroupCode) +
    # stat_summary(fun.data=mean_cl_normal) + 
    geom_smooth(method='lm', formula= y~x) + 
    xlab(paste("peak accessibility:", temp_peak)) + ylab(paste("AS PSI:", temp_feature)) + 
    guides(color = guide_legend(title = "Timepoint")) + 
    theme_minimal() + 
    ggtitle(paste0(temp_gene_symbol, ", cor = ", format(temp_cor_AS_peak$estimate, digits = 2), " (p = ", format(temp_cor_AS_peak$p.value, digits = 2), ")"))
print(p1)
ggsave(file.path("../results_SRC/example_SRC/",
                 paste0("cor-peak-AS_", temp_gene_symbol, "-", temp_peak, "-", temp_feature, ".png")),
       p1, width = 3.5, height = 2)
ggsave(file.path("../results_SRC/example_SRC/",
                 paste0("cor-peak-AS_", temp_gene_symbol, "-", temp_peak, "-", temp_feature, ".pdf")),
       p1, width = 3.5, height = 2)
ggsave(file.path("../results_SRC/example_SRC/",
```

```{r}
temp_tf_id_in_qcdat <- intersect(temp_tf_id_in_qcdat, 
                                 dadat[[tissue_select]][[ref_modality_DA]]$feature_id[dadat[[tissue_select]][[ref_modality_DA]]$adj_p_value < 0.05 & dadat[[tissue_select]][[ref_modality_DA]]$contrast == da_contrast_string_select])

for (temp_tf_id_in_qcdat_select in temp_tf_id_in_qcdat){
    
    # Add AS PSI and peak 
    temp_plot_df$AS_feature <- Matching_AS_mtx[temp_feature, temp_plot_df$cross_match_id]
    # temp_plot_df$gene_RNA <- Matching_RNA_mtx[temp_gene_id_in_qcdat, temp_plot_df$cross_match_id]
    # temp_plot_df$regulatory_peak <- Matching_ATAC_mtx[temp_peak, temp_plot_df$cross_match_id]
    temp_plot_df$TF <- temp_ref_modality_qc[temp_tf_id_in_qcdat_select, temp_plot_df$cross_match_id]
    
    temp_plot_df <- temp_plot_df[temp_plot_df$randomGroupCode == exercise_group_select, ]
    
    temp_plot_df <- temp_plot_df[!is.na(temp_plot_df$AS_feature) & !is.na(temp_plot_df$TF), ]
    
    temp_cor_AS_TF <- cor.test(temp_plot_df$AS_feature, temp_plot_df$TF, method = "pearson")
    
    p1 <- ggplot(temp_plot_df, aes(x = TF, y = AS_feature)) + 
        geom_point(aes(color = Timepoint_new)) + 
        scale_color_manual(values = annot_colors_use_list$timepoint[unique(as.character(temp_plot_df$Timepoint_new))]) + 
        # facet_grid(. ~ randomGroupCode) +
        geom_smooth(method='lm', formula= y~x) + 
        xlab(paste0("TF ", ref_modality_DA, ": ", temp_tf, " (", temp_tf_id_in_qcdat_select, ")")) + ylab(paste("AS PSI:", temp_feature)) + 
        guides(color = guide_legend(title = "Timepoint")) + 
        theme_minimal() + 
        ggtitle(paste0(temp_gene_symbol, ", cor = ", format(temp_cor_AS_TF$estimate, digits = 2), " (p = ", format(temp_cor_AS_TF$p.value, digits = 2), ")"))
    print(p1)
    ggsave(file.path("../results_SRC/example_SRC/",
                     paste0("cor-TF-AS_", temp_gene_symbol, "-", temp_tf, "-", temp_tf_id_in_qcdat_select, "-", temp_feature, ".png")),
           p1, width = 3.5, height = 2)
    ggsave(file.path("../results_SRC/example_SRC/",
                     paste0("cor-TF-AS_", temp_gene_symbol, "-", temp_tf, "-", temp_tf_id_in_qcdat_select, "-", temp_feature, ".pdf")),
           p1, width = 3.5, height = 2)
    ggsave(file.path("../results_SRC/example_SRC/",
                     paste0("cor-TF-AS_", temp_gene_symbol, "-", temp_tf, "-", temp_tf_id_in_qcdat_select, "-", temp_feature, ".svg")),
           p1, width = 3.5, height = 2)
    
    p1 <- ggplot(temp_plot_df) + 
        geom_boxplot(aes(x = Timepoint_exact, y = TF)) + 
        # scale_color_manual(values = annot_colors_use_list$timepoint[unique(as.character(temp_plot_df$Timepoint_exact))]) + 
        xlab("Timepoint") + ylab(paste0("TF ", ref_modality_DA, ": ", temp_tf, " (", temp_tf_id_in_qcdat_select, ")")) + 
        theme_minimal() + 
        theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, size = 10, hjust = 1, vjust = 1)) + 
        ggtitle(paste("TF phosphorylation: ", temp_tf))
    print(p1)
    ggsave(file.path("../results_SRC/example_SRC/",
                     paste0("box-TF_", temp_gene_symbol, "-", temp_tf, "-", temp_tf_id_in_qcdat_select, ".png")),
           p1, width = 3, height = 2)
    ggsave(file.path("../results_SRC/example_SRC/",
                     paste0("box-TF_", temp_gene_symbol, "-", temp_tf, "-", temp_tf_id_in_qcdat_select, ".pdf")),
           p1, width = 3, height = 2)
    ggsave(file.path("../results_SRC/example_SRC/",
                     paste0("box-TF_", temp_gene_symbol, "-", temp_tf, "-", temp_tf_id_in_qcdat_select, ".svg")),
           p1, width = 3, height = 2)
}
```
